title: 30166-Java, Spring Boot, Jenkins, Docker L3 (5.1-7 year)-CHE
description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position Purpose:
  
  
The Container security remediation officer (docker) is a software developer specialized and dedicated to the security management and integrity of the Docker image ecosystem. Your primary objective is to ensure the production readiness, maintainability, and security compliance of all functional, technical, and editor provided Docker images.
  
  
Acting as a critical technical link, you will work closely with developers globally to reach the security standards expected by the BNP Paribas Group. You will serve as an extended member of the Corporate Cloud DevOps COE, participating in agile rituals and providing the technical expertise necessary to deliver fresh, supported, and secure images that meet evolving business and security needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Image Lifecycle & Security Remediation

Image Hardening & Maintenance: Create, update, and ensure the security of technical, functional, and editor Docker images.
  
  
Vulnerability Remediation: Proactively identify vulnerabilities and perform the technical "fixes" (updating base images, patching dependencies, and refactoring Dockerfiles) to ensure security compliance.
  
  
Classification : Internal
  
  
Continuous Improvement: Apply developer best practices (e.g., SOLID, Craft) to ensure images are not only secure but also maintainable and scalable.
  
  
Validation & Deployment: Upon delegation, update image references and trigger CI/CD toolchains to validate the technical behavior and security integrity of new images.
  
  

* Operational Governance & Reporting

Activity Tracking: Organize and track all assigned activities, providing weekly feedback and local KPI production to the Cloud DevOps COE team.
  
  
Catalog Management: Maintain and regularly update the list of all available images (at least bi monthly) and communicate changes to developer teams.
  
  
Proactive Alerting: Actively monitor and alert development teams regarding the use of obsolete or non compliant images to prevent security regressions.
  
  
Task Prioritization: Classify and organize requests and topics to ensure alignment with priority subjects and COE objectives.
  
  
Contributing Responsibilities
  
  
Developer Advocacy: Provide functional and technical support to users during the development, build, scanning, and releasing phases.
  
  
Global Collaboration: Assist subsidiaries and partners during the onboarding phase to ensure seamless integration into the secure container ecosystem.
  
  
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
Specific Qualifications:
  
  
Containerization: Expert level knowledge of Docker and container security management.
  
  
Software Development: Proven experience in software engineering (specifically in Java, .NET, or Python) to enable deep dive vulnerability remediation.
  
  
Security & Vulnerability Management: Expert level knowledge of identifying, analyzing, and fixing security flaws within application stacks.
  
  
Toolchain Proficiency: Practical experience with CI/CD toolchains and security scanning tools.
  
  
IT Infrastructure: Strong general knowledge of IT infrastructure and cloud environments.
  
  
**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
Technical Skills:
  
  
Docker (expert level)
  
  
Java, .Net or Python
  
  
CI/CD toolchain
  
  
Classification : Internal
  
  
Behavioral Skills:
  
  
Analytical Ability: Ability to classify complex requests and prioritize key subjects effectively.
  
  
Organizational Skills & Rigor: Highly disciplined in tracking activities, maintaining documentation, and meeting reporting deadlines.
  
  
Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively within an Agile organization and act as a "Developer Advocate."
  
  
Resilience & Adaptability: Capable of managing changing priorities in a fast paced, global environment.
  
  
Communication: Ability to communicate technical security requirements clearly to diverse developer teams.
  
  
Education Level: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science
  
  
Experience level: 5+ years
  
  
Location: Chennai
  
  
Life at CGI:
  
  
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise

Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

title: AI Native Backend Engineer (Core Java, 3 Months Contract)
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design and implement moderately complex features with minimal supervision
* Contribute to system design discussions and provide input on architecture decisions
* Actively use AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate development — scaffolding features, writing tests, reviewing code, and debugging
* Leverage AI tooling to iterate quickly, reduce boilerplate, and ship production-ready code at higher velocity
* Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and adherence to team standards before merging
* Debug and troubleshoot efficiently, with well-reasoned solutions
* The engineer will own business-critical components and services powering key use cases for customers

**Ideal Candidate**

* Strong Backend Software Engineer Profile with strong Core Java expertise
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 2+ years of hands-on backend software engineering experience.
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must be able to design and implement moderately complex features with minimal supervision, and contribute to system design and architecture discussions.
* Mandatory (Experience 3): Must be comfortable owning business-critical production components — maintaining connectors, handling customer escalations, security fixes, bug fixes, and building new features end-to-end.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have strong, current Core Java depth with solid, clear coding fundamentals — Java is the primary skill for this role. Deep hands-on core engineering strength matters more than framework knowledge.
* Mandatory (Tech skill 2): Must have strong core backend engineering fundamentals and experience with scalable systems (connectors handle millions of events/data points daily across customers).
* Mandatory (AI Fluency): Must have demonstrated, hands-on use of AI coding assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of the daily workflow — scaffolding, writing tests, reviewing code, and debugging — with the ability to write precise, effective prompts for production-quality output, decompose tasks so AI assistance is effective, and critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and standards before merging.
* Mandatory (Database): Hands-on database / JDBC integration experience in a production environment.
* Mandatory (Company): Must come from a product company background (B2B SaaS or B2C both acceptable).
* Mandatory (Note1): This is a 3-month contract role. Candidate must be comfortable with the contract engagement and able to join immediately (urgent — onboarding within ~a week)
* Mandatory (Note 2): Must be based in or near Chennai, Bangalore, or Ahmedabad (Chennai: hybrid, Tue & Thu in office)
* Preferred (AI-Native): Must have actually built and deployed AI/LLM-powered features in production (e.g. RAG, LLM-based scoring, AI assistant) — demonstrable AI-native engineering, not merely using AI tools to write code.
* Preferred (Backend): Hands-on Python experience is a plus.
* Preferred (Microservices): Microservices experience is good to have but not a must. The connector work is JDBC / driver-integration heavy rather than microservices-based, so strong backend and integration depth is weighted higher; candidates without microservices exposure still qualify.

Experience: 2–6 years · Hybrid, 2 days in office · 5 days a week · Notice period less than 15 days · Also in: Bengaluru, Ahmedabad

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.
* Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.
* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
* Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.
* Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.
* Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.
* Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.
* Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.
* Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.
* AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.
* Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

Key Behaviors:
  
  

* Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.
* Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.
* Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.
* Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

Reporting Structure:
  
  
This role reports to the Innovation department lead.
  
  
Visteon Culture
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: AI Engineering IRC306669
description:

not the criterion; depth of AI delivery is)

AgentCore and/or Step Functions

Claude Code / Cowork

**Requirements**
Harness Engineering — Core

context and state management, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints around an LLM

branching, retries, parallelism and human-approval gates (e.g. task-token waits); invoke AgentCore runtimes and Lambda
  
  
from workflows

proposes, with explicit exception, timeout and loop-guard paths

scaling and invocation patterns, and expose tools via AgentCore Gateway
  
  
  

* AgentCore Observability — Hands-on tracing, metrics and logging of agent runs (AgentCore, CloudWatch, Datadog)

with a per-step audit trail to debug and monitor production workflows
  
  
  

* AgentCore Evaluation — Hands-on design and running of evaluations (AgentCore Evaluations, golden-dataset

regression tests) to measure agent quality before and after each release
  
  
  

* Guardrails — Hands-on configuration of Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and policy controls for safety, prompt-injection

defence, PII and hallucination mitigation, with human-in-the-loop review where required
  
  
Agentic AI with Claude

Code and/or Cowork

* Skill building — Design and publish reusable skills consumable by agent workflows
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) — Build, host and consume MCP servers (e.g. FastMCP on AgentCore); expose and

integrate tools for agent use, with agents reaching data only through MCP/API, never directly
  
  
  

* Multi-agent coordination — Task delegation and result aggregation across agents (A2A)
* RAG pipelines — Vector databases, chunking, embeddings and retrieval
* Prompt engineering — System prompts, evaluation and iteration

Front End
  
  
  

* AG-UI — Build agent-facing user interfaces on the AG-UI protocol, connecting the front end to running agents for

streaming responses, tool-call visibility, shared state and human approval steps
  
  
Backend
  
  
  

* Python 3.10+ — async/await, type hints
* FastAPI or equivalent Python web framework
* Basic SQL — query, filter, join; awareness of vector DBs (pgvector, Pinecone, OpenSearch)
* NoSQL — Working knowledge of document/key-value stores (e.g. Amazon DynamoDB): data modelling, access

patterns, and using them for agent run state and audit trails
  
  
  

* REST API design, JWT / OAuth2

Workflow Automation
  
  
  

* Decompose manual business processes into agent workflows
* Document processing — PDF, Excel, unstructured data extraction and classification

Proven experience in software engineering, with hands-on AI engineering shipped to production (years of experience are
  
  
not the criterion; depth of AI delivery is)
  
  
  

* At least one production project involving LLM agents, skill building, or RAG pipelines — ideally on AWS Bedrock

AgentCore and/or Step Functions

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
About Team
  
  
GDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Lead the engineering team(s) responsible for designing, building, and operating GDF's core data platform capabilities - pipelines, processing frameworks, storage layers, and service APIs that power downstream analytics and AI workloads across Walmart.
  
  
Stay hands-on: write and review production code, prototype solutions to hard technical problems, and participate directly in design and code reviews rather than delegating all technical depth to the team.
  
  
Own the engineering roadmap, technical execution, and delivery of scalable, high-throughput data services built on languages/frameworks including Java, Python, and Spark.
  
  
Guide architecture and system design decisions across distributed data processing systems, batch and streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse storage, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
Drive the design and evolution of Big Data capabilities - data ingestion, transformation, quality, observability, and governance - at the scale Walmart's platforms require.
  
  
Partner with product managers, data scientists, ML engineers, and platform/security teams to deliver reliable, well-governed data capabilities that enable downstream analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases.
  
  
Lead pragmatic integration of AI and GenAI capabilities into the data platform - e.g., feature pipelines for ML models, embeddings/vector search for retrieval, LLM-assisted data quality checks, and intelligent pipeline monitoring - wherever they create measurable engineering or business value.
  
  
Ensure systems are designed for scalability, reliability, performance, observability, security, and cost efficiency, appropriate for petabyte-scale enterprise data platforms.
  
  
Lead engineering execution across the full software development lifecycle - design, coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and ongoing operational excellence.
  
  
Champion DevOps, platform engineering, and automation best practices to improve engineering velocity, reduce toil, and support continuous delivery for a newly formed team building process and standards from scratch.
  
  
Establish engineering standards through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, testing strategy, observability practices, and production readiness reviews.
  
  
Define and track engineering and data quality metrics - availability, latency, pipeline SLAs, data freshness, defect rates, deployment frequency, incident trends, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Hire, mentor, and develop hands-on engineers, building a high-performing team culture grounded in craftsmanship, ownership, and continuous learning.
  
  
Build strong cross-functional relationships across engineering, product, data science, and business teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
  
  
Continuously evaluate emerging Big Data, cloud, and AI/ML technologies, applying them pragmatically where they improve platform reliability, engineering productivity, or business value.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience building and operating large-scale data platforms, distributed systems, and backend services.
  
  
4+ years of engineering leadership experience, including managing engineers and leading technical teams through complex delivery programs.
  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Genuinely hands-on: comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging production code - not just directing others. Strong proficiency in Java and Python is required; working knowledge of Spark for distributed data processing is expected.
  
  
Strong exposure to Big Data technologies and ecosystems - Spark, Hadoop/HDFS, Hive, Kafka, or equivalent - including batch and streaming data processing, data pipeline design, and large-scale data transformation.
  
  
Experience with data platform fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT pipeline design, data quality and observability, data governance, and integration with enterprise data lakes/lakehouses (e.g., Delta Lake, BigQuery, Databricks).
  
  
Strong experience with microservices architectures, distributed systems, event-driven patterns, API design, and enterprise system integration.

title: Senior Manager - Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
SENIOR MANAGER - FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

**Location: Chennai (on site) | Type: Fulltime**

About Newpage Solutions

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘
**Great Place to Work®’ certified**
company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top
**Glassdoor rating**
and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

**Your Mission**

We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to take the hardest AI problems in Finance and Global Business Services from whiteboard to production for a global pharmaceutical company, and to set the patterns the rest of the team builds on. You will join a function team, define the problem, and lead the build from first prototype through production handoff and support, taking the engagements that span multiple systems or teams in areas such as financial close, forecasting, accounts receivable, procure-to-pay, tax, treasury and shared services operations.

This is a senior hands-on individual contributor and technical lead role in the company's Finance and Global Business Services technology and AI capability center in Chennai. You will set the engineering patterns other Forward Deployed Engineers follow, review their designs and code, and still write code every week, alongside Product Owners, process owners, and digital platform and architecture teams. You will work directly with Finance and Global Business Services leaders worldwide, so you find out fast whether what you build works. You can grow your career through technical leadership without moving into people management. Success is measured by adoption, demonstrable business outcomes (time saved, quality, risk, controls, cycle time, better decisions, financial impact) and how much of your work others reuse.

The role needs regular overlap with US and European time zones, including some early-evening IST calls, and can be demanding at times, including period-end close support and leading the response to production incidents. You don't need every bonus skill listed. If you have led AI into production that people use and want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Problem Discovery and Business Partnership**

* Work in person in Chennai while embedding virtually with assigned Finance and Global Business Services teams.
* Lead discovery for complex, cross-functional use cases through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs and process reviews with senior stakeholders and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe, and shape them into roadmaps with measurable outcomes.
* Work with Product Owners to turn priorities and specifications into solution designs and delivery plans, and to rank use cases by value, feasibility and risk.
* Say no, or not yet, when a use case lacks data, sponsorship or a clear value case, and push back when a specification doesn't match the underlying problem or runs into technical issues and limitations.

**Technical Leadership and Build**

* Serve as technical lead on complex engagements: own solution design, stay hands-on in the code, and lead the design of agentic AI built with frontier models on the company's enterprise AI platforms.
* Design multi-agent and multi-step workflows on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and other market-leading runtimes, using frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph and Lang Chain, with MCP, A2A and APIs connecting enterprise systems, deterministic business rules and human approval steps.
* Set coding standards, evaluation practice and quality bars for the engagements you lead, including review standards for AI-generated code.
* Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow to speed delivery, show other engineers how to use them well, and make build-versus-buy and platform choices with digital platform and architecture teams.

**Data and Enterprise Integration**

* Lead integration across Finance and Global Business Services data and systems through governed MCP tools or APIs and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, other enterprise platforms and custom solutions.
* Help shape a shared Finance and Global Business Services data and AI foundation (ontology, rules engine, MCP tool library and decision ledger), and decide which patterns become shared building blocks.
* Define data contracts, semantic models and access patterns, and extend the shared ontology and business rules, such as Delegation of Authority, Segregation of Duties and materiality, that other engineers and agents reuse.
* Set data access, entitlement and classification practice for financial and personal data on the engagements you lead.

**Controls, Compliance and Responsible AI**

* Own control design for your solutions. Engage SOX, Internal Audit, Privacy, Legal, Security and AI governance early, including data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act) and EU AI Act review, and pass required gates before release.
* Define evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, drift and failure modes on financial outputs, and make sure agent evidence, approvals and actions are recorded in the decision ledger.
* Enforce responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, human review and output monitoring.

**Production, Reliability and Reuse**

* Own production readiness and ongoing support for the solutions you lead: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response and run costs.
* Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer and root cause analysis for production solutions.
* Set the standard for logging, tracing, monitoring and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights and Foundry Observability.
* Convert proven solutions into reusable components, templates and accelerators across Finance and Global Business Services, and identify and pay down technical debt before it blocks scale.

**Mentoring, Value and Adoption**

* Mentor Manager-level Forward Deployed Engineers, and engineers in Finance and Global Business Services function teams, through design reviews, pairing and code review.
* Contribute to Forward Deployed Engineering playbooks, interview loops and team upskilling.
* Build business cases and track realized value: hours saved, cycle time, cost avoidance and risk reduction.
* Present results and tradeoffs to senior Finance and Global Business Services stakeholders and Forward Deployed Engineering leadership, and build champions in the business so adoption sticks.

**What You Bring**

**Engineering and AI Delivery**

* 10+ years of software or data engineering experience, including at least three years building and shipping LLM-based applications to production, with at least one multi-step agentic system with tool use, evaluation and monitoring.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.
* Technical lead experience on complex, multi-system builds.
* Expert-level Python, with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL.
* Hands-on experience with cloud architecture, ideally Azure; AWS is also considered. Includes API-first design, CI/CD and observability.
* Hands-on LLMOps practice: evaluation, tracing, and prompt, model and agent versioning.
* Daily use of AI coding agents in your own engineering work, with the judgement to review AI-generated code.

**Business Partnership and Leadership**

* Able to partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers.
* Proven ability to influence senior business stakeholders without formal authority.
* Experience mentoring engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A Master's degree in a technical field, or a finance or accounting background combined with engineering experience.
* Deep knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, FP&A or treasury, or prior work in finance technology.
* Experience integrating with SAP (S/4HANA, GTS, Ariba), Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML), Vertex AI or Oracle EPM; comparable enterprise platforms are also considered.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph or Lang Chain, MCP server development and A2A; other orchestration frameworks are also considered.
* Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs or rules engines.
* Experience with SOX and IT general controls in a regulated industry.
* Experience turning bespoke solutions into reusable platforms or products.
* AWS or Azure Solutions Architect or Developer certification, or the equivalent on other market-leading platforms.

**What We Offer**

At Newpage, we’re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

**Ready to Apply?**

Let’s build the future of health together. Apply below or reach out to:

*Ramadevi.bhumireddy@newpage.io*

**About Lynk (Name has been changed to Elveo)**

Elveo is the inventor of satellite direct to device or D2D technology, and has the world’s only commercial license from the FCC to operate a commercial D2D system. Today, Lynk allows mobile network operators' subscribers to send and receive text messages to and from space via standard unmodified, mobile devices. Lynk’s service has been tested and proven on all seven continents, has regulatory approvals in more than 30 countries and is currently being deployed commercially based on more than 40 MNO commercial service contracts covering approximately 50 countries.

Our technology will enable all 8 billion people on the planet to stay connected with the existing standard phone in their pocket. Everywhere. No matter what.

By joining Lynk, you will have the opportunity to directly touch the lives of billions. Your mission will be to bring mobile broadband to billions, pull hundreds of millions out of poverty, and save countless lives.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Lynk, you will be a technical leader in designing, building, and operating the software that powers our satellites and ground network. You will set the standard for engineering excellence, mentor other engineers, and take on our most complex challenges in distributed systems, real-time software, and global-scale operations.

* Demonstrable experience designing and building complex, scalable, and reliable software systems.
* Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems design.
* Exceptional communication (written and verbal) and documentation skills, with a proven ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to diverse audiences.
* A highly collaborative, team-oriented, and positive attitude, with a knack for mentoring and elevating the entire team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional experience with C++ and Python.
* Experience designing scalable and modular solutions, including multi-threaded applications and stateless services.
* Experience developing with networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP) and building distributed systems.

* Experience with modern monitoring, data analysis, and visualization tools.
* Experience with Linux-based development environments.
* A creative and analytical approach to solving ambiguous and complex technical problems.
* Proven ability to thrive and provide technical leadership in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* A passion for tackling complex problems and taking full ownership from concept to completion.
* Interest in or experience with networking, wireless protocols, or telecommunications (e.g., 2G/GSM, 4G/LTE) is a plus, but not required.

The Boomi Integration Engineer designs, builds, and maintains integrations across Access’s core enterprise systems using the
**Boomi platform, connecting SQL Server (Mandate)**
, (Nice to have) - NetSuite, Salesforce, ADP, and other applications. This role owns the Boomi processes, connectors, and runtime environments that keep data accurate and systems reliable. * Develop reusable Boomi patterns for invoking AI services within integration processes.
* Manage and secure API keys, tokens, and credentials in accordance with enterprise security practices. Partner with security and architecture teams to ensure compliant handling of sensitive information, including personally identifiable information (PII) and financial data.
* Monitor AI-related integrations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, and document integration patterns and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with the AI Platform Administrator, who owns MCP configuration within AI platforms, AI governance, and usage reporting, as well as with IT and Enterprise Architecture (EA) application owners.

**Required**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience building and supporting integrations on the Boomi integration platform as a service (iPaaS).
* Hands-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.
* Strong Boomi troubleshooting and debugging skills, including analyzing process execution logs, implementing error handling, and enhancing existing integrations using documentation and logs.
* Experience with SQL and relational databases, such as SQL Server.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience integrating with Salesforce or NetSuite.
* Experience with MDM platforms, preferably Tamr, particularly in data mapping.

* Familiarity with authentication methods, including OAuth, API keys, and single sign-on (SSO).
* Understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability in integration platforms.
* Familiarity with secrets management tools, such as Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.
* Exposure to AI/LLM platforms or APIs, such as OpenAI, Claude, or Azure OpenAI, or a willingness to learn.
* Experience with other iPaaS platforms, such as MuleSoft or Workato, is a plus.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Exposure to modern AI platforms and real-world AI integration use cases.

**Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving

* Attention to Detail

title: Associate Director, Software Architecture
description:
**About Us**
Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Technical Architect who is currently active in hands-on engineering and brings deep expertise across messaging systems, Java-based backend technologies, large-scale distributed architecture, and modern cloud-native delivery. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of architecture and engineering — capable of drawing design blueprints in the morning and writing production code or conducting a proof of concept in the afternoon.
  
  
This is a practitioner-first role. You will be expected to make informed architectural decisions grounded in proven patterns, lead by example in technical execution, and mentor engineering teams through complex design and delivery challenges. You should be comfortable using AI/LLM tools in your day-to-day work and have the ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI-enabled solutions where they add clear value.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Hands-On Architecture & Design
  
  

* Design and evolve large-scale, distributed systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance, including AI/LLM-enabled components where appropriate.
* Make well-reasoned architectural decisions based on proven patterns such as Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, Saga, Circuit Breaker, and API Gateway, and apply similar rigor to AI integrations (guardrails, fallbacks, observability).
* Create clear architecture blueprints, sequence diagrams, and technical specifications to guide engineering teams, including designs for services that interact with LLM APIs or AI workflows.
* Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and sprint ceremonies to ensure architectural alignment, and leverage AI tools to accelerate reviews, refactoring, and documentation where suitable

Messaging & Integration Systems
  
  

* Design and implement messaging solutions using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, and ActiveMQ.
* Leverage Apache Camel for enterprise integration patterns, routing, and transformation pipelines, including integration with AI/LLM services where relevant.
* Ensure high-throughput, fault-tolerant messaging architectures that meet SLA requirements.
* Evaluate and recommend the right messaging technology based on use-case, volume, and latency requirements.

Software Engineering (Java & Spring Ecosystem)
  
  

* Develop and review production-quality code in Java and Spring Boot, leading by technical example, and use AI/LLM tools to assist with boilerplate, tests, and refactoring while maintaining high quality.
* Champion microservices best practices including API design, service decomposition, and inter-service communication, including secure and observable integration with AI services.
* Conduct and lead Proof of Concepts (POCs) for evaluating new frameworks, libraries, and technologies.
* Ensure adherence to coding standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices, including safe and responsible use of AI-generated code and suggestions.

Containerization, Kubernetes & Cloud
  
  

* Design and oversee containerized deployment strategies using Docker and Kubernetes (K8s).
* Manage workload orchestration, autoscaling, resource quotas, and namespace design on Kubernetes clusters.
* Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to build robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code practices, incorporating AI-enabled tooling to improve productivity and reliability.
* Ensure container security, network policies, and secrets management are baked into the architecture.

Observability & Performance Monitoring
  
  

* Establish and embed observability frameworks covering distributed tracing, structured logging, and metrics collection.
* Define performance monitoring and alerting standards across services and infrastructure.
* Conduct performance profiling and tuning of Java applications including JVM, heap, and GC optimization.
* Lead performance benchmarking exercises and resolve bottlenecks in high-traffic, latency-sensitive systems.

Memory Management & Performance Tuning
  
  

* Demonstrate deep expertise in JVM memory management — heap sizing, GC strategies, metaspace, and memory leak analysis.
* Utilize profiling tools (e.g., JProfiler, VisualVM, async-profiler) to diagnose and resolve performance issues.
* Tune application performance at the code, runtime, and infrastructure levels.
* Define best practices for resource utilization and memory-efficient programming patterns.

Database Architecture (RDBMS & NoSQL)
  
  

* Design relational data models and optimize queries for PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL.
* Architect NoSQL solutions using MongoDB including schema design, indexing strategies, and aggregation pipelines.
* Define data access patterns, connection pooling strategies, and caching layers.
* Ensure data consistency, integrity, and resilience across distributed data stores.

Proof of Concepts & Innovation
  
  

* Proactively identify technology gaps and propose PoCs to validate architectural decisions before broader adoption, including AI/LLM-based approaches where they can improve productivity, reliability, or customer outcomes.
* Work hands-on with engineering teams during PoC phases to prototype and evaluate solutions.
* Translate PoC outcomes into actionable architectural recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

What You Bring
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  

* 12 to 16 years of progressive hands-on experience in software engineering with a strong architecture track record.
* Currently active in coding and engineering — not purely a management or advisory role.
* Demonstrable expertise in Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, and Apache Camel.
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for building enterprise-grade microservices and APIs.
* Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems that handle high volumes and strict SLAs.
* Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and containerization including production cluster operations.
* Expertise in observability practices — distributed tracing (e.g., Jaeger, Zipkin), logging (ELK/EFK), and metrics (Prometheus/Grafana).
* Strong understanding of JVM internals, memory management, and performance tuning techniques.
* Solid experience with both RDBMS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).
* Ability to make architecture decisions grounded in established patterns and proven engineering principles.
* Experience conducting and leading Proof of Concepts (PoCs) end-to-end.
* Comfortable using AI/LLM tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in day-to-day work for design, coding, reviews, documentation, and debugging.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand, learn, and implement AI/LLM-based solutions and integrate them pragmatically into enterprise architectures when they add clear value.

Nice-to-Haves
  
  

* Experience in payments, financial messaging, or regulated financial technology platforms.
* Exposure to event sourcing, stream processing (e.g., Kafka Streams, Apache Flink).
* Experience with chaos engineering and resilience testing practices.
* Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs or using AI frameworks (e.g., Spring AI, LangChain4j, or similar) in Java-based systems.
* Familiarity with vector databases or vector search (e.g., pgvector, Weaviate, Pinecone, Milvus) and RAG patterns.
* Exposure to responsible-AI practices in production (data governance, auditability, cost/latency monitoring, human-in-the-loop where needed).

What We Offer

✔ Health benefits

✔ Professional development support

Chennai / Pune

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

A day in the life
  
  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.
  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.
  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times
  
  
**About The Team**
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
* Knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as C, C++, Java, or Perl
* Experience with automation, testing, or monitoring framework development
* 1+ years of DevOps or SysOps in a large-scale software development environment experience
* Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Knowledge of and proficiency in the use of Python scripting language
* Experience on highly concurrent, high throughput systems and knowledge of complex distributed systems
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience developing and executing campaigns across a multitude of timezones and languages
* Experience with software development lifecycle, or experience in software development

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**

Seeking an experienced Senior C++ Engineer to join the team building our next-generation embedded writer platform. The selected candidate will be responsible for porting core application logic from a legacy real-time embedded platform to a modern embedded Linux system, and for building the regression-testing infrastructure that proves the ported software behaves identically to the original. This role requires strong expertise in modern C++ development, cross-platform porting, protocol and file-format design, and test-harness engineering, applied to software that produces a legally significant data record and therefore cannot tolerate correctness regressions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Port core application and domain logic from a legacy RTOS-based C/C++ codebase to a Linux-based embedded platform, preserving exact functional behavior.
* Design and build an automated regression harness that replays historical input data through both the legacy and ported implementations and verifies bit-exact output equivalence; integrate this harness into continuous integration so every change is verified automatically.
* Reconcile divergent copies of shared logic that evolved independently on different platforms into a single, verified, canonical implementation.
* Design and implement serialization and communication protocol logic (framing, checksums, versioning) ensuring wire-level compatibility with existing external client software.
* Rework legacy file- and storage-management logic that is tightly coupled to a proprietary real-time operating system into a clean implementation on a standard Linux filesystem, while preserving on-disk data formats and data-safety guarantees (no data loss on crash or power loss).
* Port cryptography and data-integrity logic, and extend it to support a tamper-evident, cryptographically signed data journal.
* Port audio codec/compression logic into a new platform-appropriate audio pipeline. • Design clean internal interfaces (abstraction seams) that isolate ported business logic from platform-specific concerns, without building a full compatibility-emulation layer.
* Collaborate with platform, firmware, QA, and program leadership to align on process boundaries, data-safety guarantees, and real-time performance budgets.
* Participate in design and code review, with particular attention to correctness on the legally-sensitive data-capture path.
* Utilize modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate large-scale code translation and test generation, while applying independent engineering judgment to verify correctness rather than trusting generated output at face value.
* Support the product from early architecture through production release

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of professional C++ software development experience, including production/shipping systems. • Strong experience with modern C++ (C++14/17/20).
* Demonstrated experience porting or migrating a large existing codebase across platforms or operating systems (e.g., RTOS to Linux, or similar cross-platform migration).
* Experience designing or implementing serialization formats or communication protocols (framing, checksums, versioning, backward compatibility).
* Solid understanding of concurrent/multithreaded programming.
* Hands-on experience with Linux operating systems in an embedded or application context.
* Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and software design skills.
* A test-first, verification-driven approach to correctness, with experience building or operating automated regression or golden-master style test harnesses.
* Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Demonstrated, hands-on effectiveness with AI-assisted software engineering tools (agentic coding assistants, AI-based code review), with clear judgment about when to trust generated output and when it requires independent verification.
* Experience using Git for version control and standard issue-tracking tools for project/task management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with embedded cryptography, data integrity, or licensing/security subsystems. • Experience with audio codec integration or digital signal processing basics.
* Experience with hash-chained, append-only, or tamper-evident log/journal data structures.
* Familiarity with embedded Linux storage semantics (journaling filesystems, write-through/O\_SYNC data-safety patterns, flash/eMMC wear considerations).
* Prior experience in a regulated, safety-critical, or legal/records-integrity software domain.
* Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to software architecture decisions.
* Experience working in Agile development environments.

**Required Skills**

* AI-Assisted Software Development
* C++ (14/17/20) • Embedded Linux
* Cross-Platform Porting / Migration
* Multithreading
* Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
* Serialization & Protocol Design
* Automated/Regression Test Harness Design
* Cryptography & Data Integrity
* Git
* Debugging & Troubleshooting
* Software Design & Architecture

The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Test Engineering ("ETE") family is responsible for ensuring that all applications and systems meet defined quality standards. The ETE family encompasses three major areas including (a) functional testing, (b) non-functional testing, and (c) test architecture and enablement. Other key focuses include: regression testing, browser testing, performance testing, capacity and stress testing, resiliency testing, environment management services, and infrastructure testing. Develops, conducts, and evaluates testing processes, working closely with developers to remediate identified system defects. In-depth knowledge of automated testing tools, and quality control and assurance approaches including the creation of reusable foundational test automation framework for the entire organization. The Resiliency Test Engineering role is responsible for the validation of non-functional requirements for resiliency testing.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Deepen understanding of the DTCC Software Delivery Process and proactively identify opportunities for improvement within assigned responsibilities.
* Execute performance test scenarios based on user stories, requirements, and application architecture.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance performance test scripts using Apache JMeter and other automation frameworks.
* Design and implement test automation solutions to support performance, scalability, and resiliency validation.
* Create and maintain Jenkins CI/CD pipelines to automate performance test execution, reporting, and continuous validation.
* Develop and maintain Groovy-based Jenkins pipeline scripts for test orchestration and automation workflows.
* Execute and manage performance tests using BlazeMeter, including test scheduling, execution, analysis, and reporting.
* Analyze test results, identify performance bottlenecks, and provide actionable recommendations to development and engineering teams.
* Track execution of performance test scenarios and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Build knowledge of Delivery Pipeline components and recommend enhancements to improve automation, efficiency, and reliability.
* Develop a strong understanding of the products, applications, and business processes being delivered.
* Follow DTCC performance engineering standards, policies, and procedures in day-to-day activities.
* Demonstrate strong technical ability to develop scripts, write code, and automate testing processes.
* Align risk and control processes with daily responsibilities to monitor, mitigate, and appropriately escalate risk.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in Performance Engineering, Test Automation, Software Development, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing and executing performance tests using Apache JMeter.
* Experience using BlazeMeter for performance test management, execution, reporting, and analysis.
* Experience building and maintaining Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience developing automation solutions using Groovy scripting.
* Strong programming experience in Java and object-oriented design principles.
* Experience with Python for automation, test engineering, scripting, and data processing.
* Familiarity with source control tools such as Git/Bitbucket.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, and Continuous Testing practices.

Talents Needed for Success
  
  

* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively within and across teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to review deliverables and ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to standards.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with Java development, including APIs, multithreading, Spring Boot, and enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience developing and maintaining Groovy scripts for Jenkins pipeline automation.
* Experience integrating JMeter and BlazeMeter within CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with Python development for automation and tooling.
* Experience with React development, including building and maintaining modern web-based applications and dashboards.
* Ability to troubleshoot application and performance issues using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.
* Understanding of performance engineering concepts including: - Load Testing
* Stress Testing
* Endurance/Soak Testing
* Scalability Testing
* Capacity Planning
* Performance Tuning
* Bottleneck Analysis

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience working with enterprise-scale distributed systems and cloud-based applications.
* Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting high-volume transactional applications in financial services environments.
* Familiarity with resiliency testing, failure mode analysis, and non-functional requirements (NFR) validation

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
  
  
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
  
  
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Implements performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
  
  
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
  
  
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
  
  
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
  
  
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
  
  
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
  
  
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
  
  
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
  
  
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements.
  
  
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Run our preflight and regression checks, test as real user roles, keep rollback versions, and never test against live customer data or send real emails or SMS from a build.Present the solution to owners, ops managers and finance leads. Explain what the system does in plain language, record walkthrough videos, and keep the customer hub up to date.Support live customers. Debug reported issues down to the root cause, fix them with a versioned change, and write up what happened.Document what you build so the next build is faster: reusable kits, patterns and known traps.What we’re looking forStrong SQL and PostgreSQL. You read schemas fast, write correct joins and updates, and understand constraints, defaults, permissions and functions.Comfortable with JSON and APIs. Nested configs, REST and webhooks, auth headers. You can read an error and know where to look.AI-native working style. You already use Claude, Cursor or similar tools every day, and you check AI output instead of trusting it.Systems thinking. You see that a status written on the technician’s phone has to appear on the office list, and that a rule firing at 2 a.m. needs a timezone guard.Customer sense. You can sit with a fencing company or a facilities director, find the real problem, and push back on the wrong solution.Clear communication, written and spoken, with technical and non-technical people across the US, UK, Canada, Australia/NZ and India.Ownership. You ship, check your own work and close the loop with the customer without being chased.Nice to haveJavaScript, Python or HTML/CSS (code widgets and scripts)Experience with field service, construction, facilities or trades operationsExperience with workflow automation (n8n, Zapier, Make) or LLM agents and tool callingExperience with Twilio, email deliverability or payments integrationsWhat we offerYou’ll build real operations software for real companies every week, not slideware.You’ll work at the front of AI-first enterprise software: agents, MCP, AI-written configuration.You’ll work directly with the founding team and with customers, and have real say in what the product becomes.Competitive pay and fast growth as we scale.

* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards; coordinate with InfoSec and legal teams.

**Customer Success & Enablement**

* Create client-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.
* Monitor post-deployment health: performance metrics, drift, model evaluation, user feedback loops.

* Collaborate with Sales/Pre-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.

**Required Skills & Competencies**
**Technical**

* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human-in-the-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.

**Client-Facing**

* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.

**Mindset**

* Outcome-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.

**Qualifications**

* 6–10+ years in Client-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3+ years hands-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.

**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**

* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance & governance: redaction, PII detection, audit-ready conversation logs.

**Tools & Tech Stack (Illustrative)**

* Cloud & Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability & Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.
* Security: OAuth2/OIDC, RBAC, KMS, DLP; Responsible AI guardrails & content filters.
