title: Technical Lead – Backend Systems
company: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited
description:
🚀
**We're Hiring | Technical Lead – Backend Systems**

**Location:**
Chennai, Work from Office

**Experience:**
12– 15+ Years

**Technology:**
Python | FastAPI | PostgreSQL | Distributed Systems | Cloud

Are you a hands-on backend engineering leader who enjoys solving complex architectural challenges, building scalable systems, and driving engineering excellence?

We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Lead – Backend Systems**
to take ownership of backend architecture, system design, and engineering standards.

This is an opportunity for someone who goes beyond writing code — someone who can make sound architectural decisions, build robust distributed systems, and guide engineering teams in delivering high-quality technology solutions.

🔹 What You'll Be Responsible For

**1. Backend Architecture & System Design**

* Own end-to-end backend architecture and technical design.
* Design scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems.
* Define service boundaries, data ownership, and communication patterns.
* Evaluate architectural approaches including Microservices, Modular Monoliths, Event-Driven and Hexagonal Architectures.
* Drive critical technology decisions and document architecture through design diagrams, ADRs and technical specifications.

**2. Hands-on Backend Engineering**

* Architect and develop high-performance backend services using
  **Python and FastAPI**
  .
* Build REST APIs, asynchronous services, and background processing workflows.
* Drive clean code practices, SOLID principles, design patterns, and engineering quality.
* Lead code reviews and optimize system performance.

**3. Database & Data Architecture**

* Design and optimize relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MySQL.
* Work with NoSQL technologies such as MongoDB, DynamoDB and Redis.
* Drive database schema design, indexing, query optimization, transactions, and data migrations.
* Make informed data-store decisions based on performance, consistency, and scalability requirements.

**4. Distributed Systems & Scalability**

* Design systems that support horizontal scaling and high availability.
* Handle fault tolerance, retries, timeouts, idempotency, and distributed transactions.
* Work with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ and AWS SQS.
* Understand eventual consistency, replication, and failure-handling strategies.

**5. Cloud, DevOps & Engineering Practices**

* Work with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Drive containerization using Docker and deployment through CI/CD pipelines.
* Understand Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Partner with DevOps/SRE teams on monitoring, logging, tracing, and observability.

**6. Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical owner for backend engineering systems.
* Mentor and guide senior and mid-level engineers.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural guidelines, and best practices.
* Collaborate with Product, Architecture, and Business teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.

🔹 What We're Looking For

**Must-Have Skills**

* 12+ years of backend/software engineering experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on production experience with
  **FastAPI**
  .
* Expert-level proficiency in
  **Python**
  .
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL/MySQL and at least one NoSQL database.
* Deep understanding of backend architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, and DDD concepts.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems and scalable application design.
* Proven ability to own architecture and make independent technical decisions.

**Good to Have**

* Experience architecting and evolving large-scale enterprise systems.
* Experience with monolith-to-microservices transformations.
* Hands-on exposure to event-driven and streaming architectures.
* Strong understanding of API gateways, rate limiting, OAuth2 and JWT.
* Experience with cloud-native deployments and Kubernetes.
* Previous experience as a Senior Backend Engineer, Technical Lead, or Solution Architect.

🔹 Who Would Be a Great Fit?

Someone who:

* Is still passionate about writing and reviewing code.
* Thinks architecturally but understands implementation-level details.
* Can balance scalability, performance, cost, and engineering complexity.
* Takes ownership of technology decisions rather than simply following specifications.
* Can influence engineering teams through technical depth and leadership.

**If building robust backend platforms and solving complex engineering challenges excites you, we'd love to hear from you!**

📩

Apply through LinkedIn

title: NewPage - Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER**
**Location :**
Chennai
  
  
**Type :**
Fulltime.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives.
  
  
We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years.
  
  
We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.
  
  
As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end.
  
  
You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team.
  
  
You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Problem / Opportunity Discovery :
* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck.
* Reframe problems out loud.
* Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.
* Build (fast) with AI :
* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help : vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.
* Test, Deploy, Productionize :
* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline : hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks.
* Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production : TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models.
* You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture.
* You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters.
  
  
**We Offer**

* A people-first culture : Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential.

**The opportunity**

This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. title: Software Technical Lead
description:
**Job Description**
Be part of the solution at Technip Energies and embark on a one-of-a-kind journey. You will be helping to develop cutting-edge solutions to solve real-world energy problems.
  
  
We are currently seeking a
**Lead full Stack Developer**
, to join our Chennai Team, and this position will be directly reporting to Head of the Department.
  
  
**About us:**
Technip Energies is a global technology and engineering powerhouse. With leadership positions in LNG, hydrogen, ethylene, sustainable chemistry, and CO2 management, we are contributing to the development of critical markets such as energy, energy derivatives, decarbonization, and circularity. Our complementary business segments, Technology, Products and Services (TPS) and Project Delivery, turn innovation into scalable and industrial reality.
  
  
Through collaboration and excellence in execution, our 17,000+ employees across 34 countries are fully committed to bridging prosperity with sustainability for a world designed to last.
  
  
**About the mission we offer you:**
As a Lead Full Stack Developer, the candidate will be responsible for leading the design, development, and delivery of a scalable and high-performance application. They will work in collaboration with a team of full-stack developers in a Scrum-based environment, under the guidance of a Business Application Owner.
  
  
The Lead Developer will play a critical role in ensuring the technical quality of the application by promoting best practices, ensuring secure coding standards, and optimizing performance. The candidate is expected to mentor team members, provide technical leadership, and act as the primary point of contact for technical challenges. A deep understanding of the business domain and the ability to translate complex functional requirements into scalable technical solutions are essential for success in this role.
  
  
This role also requires hands-on technical expertise to address challenges in system design, database architecture, integration with microservices, and cloud deployment. The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality software solutions that align with business needs.
  
  
**Qualifications / Skills:**

* Software Development: 8 to 12 years of experience in web software development with demonstrated leadership capabilities.
* Database Expertise: 6+ years of hands-on experience with SQL Server, database optimization, and writing complex queries.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently.

***Starting Date: Immediately***
**About you:**
We love to hear from you and how you match with this position. To be successful in this mission you should consider the following requirements:
  
  
**Assignment, Context, Job Main Challenges & Key Expectations:**

* Learning Curve: The candidate is expected to quickly acquire deep knowledge of the application’s technical and business context.
* Team Leadership: The candidate will mentor and guide the development team, ensuring they follow best practices in coding, design, and testing.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Close collaboration with Product Owners (POs), test leads, and business stakeholders to refine user stories, resolve ambiguities, and ensure technical feasibility.
* Technical Ownership: The candidate will own the design, development, and delivery of complex modules, ensuring the application is secure, maintainable, and scalable.
* Code Quality and Security: The candidate is expected to champion DevSecOps practices, embedding security throughout the CI/CD pipeline and software development lifecycle. This
* includes advocating secure coding practices and leveraging tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to improve code quality and detect vulnerabilities.

+ Continuous Improvement: Staying updated with emerging technologies and proactively identifying opportunities to enhance the application and development processes.

**Job Scope:**

* Analyze user stories and oversee the translation of functional requirements into technical tasks.
* Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture solutions.
* Optimize database schema design, queries, and application performance.
* Ensure robust documentation, comprehensive unit testing, and effective resolution of issues.
* Act as a mentor and guide to the development team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and promoting a culture of technical excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Actively participate in and lead all Agile ceremonies daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, demos, and refinements.
* Collaborate with Product Owners (POs), developers, and other stakeholders to refine user stories and provide technical insights.
* Estimate user stories, allocate tasks, and guide team members during refinement and sprint planning.
* Implement user stories with clean, maintainable, and secure code.
* Design scalable and reliable architecture while ensuring adherence to security and performance benchmarks.
* Utilize tools such as SonarQube and Snyk to identify and resolve code vulnerabilities, technical debt, and code smells.
* Conduct and oversee thorough code reviews to maintain quality and enforce secure coding practices.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into the CI/CD pipeline, including automated security scanning using SonarQube (SAST) and Snyk (dependency/container vulnerability checks), secrets management, DAST, and compliance-as-code, ensuring security is a shared responsibility across the development lifecycle.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate coding, automate code review feedback, enforce code quality standards, and generate documentation; evaluate and responsibly adopt AI/ML capabilities within the application where they deliver measurable business value.
* Ensure responsible use of AI tools in line with company AI policy: review all AI-generated code before merge and never share confidential or client data in prompts.
* Manage Azure cloud resources, Azure API Management, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
* Design and write comprehensive unit test cases to ensure high reliability and code coverage.
* Debug and resolve complex issues identified in QA, UAT, pre-production, and production environments.
* Provide production support, troubleshoot issues, and ensure system reliability during hyper-care and beyond.
* Mentor team members, facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, and foster team development.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and propose their adoption when relevant.
* Lead strategies for code cleanup, performance optimization, and process improvements.
* Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and own the technical roadmap for the application.
* Track and manage technical debt as a prioritized backlog item, agreed with the Product Owner.
* Lead incident management for production issues, including root cause analysis (RCA) and preventive actions.
* Coordinate with other application teams, vendors, and infrastructure and cyber security teams, including support for architecture and security reviews.
* Participate in technical interviews and contribute to hiring and onboarding developers.

**Success Measures (KPIs):**

* Sprint predictability: committed versus delivered story points.
* Defect leakage to UAT and production.
* Unit test code coverage meeting the agreed target.
* SonarQube quality gate pass rate on all pipelines.
* Closure of security vulnerabilities (SonarQube, Snyk) within the agreed SLA.
* Timely resolution of production incidents with completed RCA.
* Growth in team capability through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM)

**Your career with us**
Working at Technip Energies is an inspiring journey, filled with groundbreaking projects and dynamic collaborations. Surrounded by diverse and talented individuals, you will feel welcomed, respected, and engaged. Enjoy a safe, caring environment where you can spark new ideas, reimagine the future, and lead change. As your career grows, you will benefit from learning opportunities at T.EN University, such as The Future Ready Program, Graduate Program, and from the support of your manager through check-in moments like the Mid-Year Development Review, fostering continuous growth and development.
  
  
**What’s Next?**
Once receiving your system application, our recruiting team will screen and match your skills, experience, and potential team fit against the role requirements. We ask for your patience as the team completes the volume of applications with reasonable timeframe. Check your application progress periodically via personal account from created candidate profile during your application.
  
  
We invite you to get to know more about our company by visiting www.ten.com and follow us on LinkedIn , Instagram , Facebook , X and YouTube for company updates.

title: Principal Engineer - Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**About the job**
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
  
  
It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
  
  
One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Work with a strong team of engineers to help evolve Confluent Connect. Work closely with product management, engineering leadership, and other key stakeholders across various teams in Confluent to build and drive the overall roadmap.
* Drive the long-term direction and strategy of Confluent Kafka connectors, while partnering with internal stakeholders to drive the team’s mission forward
* Drive the technical charter for Connect, and create competitive advantages for Kafka connectors by driving innovation. Drive improvements in the Kafka connectors to make them more usable and powerful for customers, and make them easier to adopt and scale.
* Mentor a team of high-performing engineers and leads, helping them to continue in growing their skill set through hands-on experience and mentorship. Provide timely and productive feedback, encourage a growth mindset, and advise team members in setting and working toward personal development goals.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement and prioritise large and high-impact initiatives that will fundamentally change Kafka connectors.
* Be a strong technical leader and representative for engineering teams in India. Nurture a culture of excellence on the team through a focus on hiring, communication, execution, and work quality. Create and manage processes that enable the team to do its best work.
* Continue a strong growth trajectory by hiring top tier engineers, and establish quality standards, design principles, and operational maturity for the team

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on software development experience with the ability to anticipate future technical needs for the product and craft plans to realize them.
* Taking ideas to production is something we look for. Ready to roll up your sleeves - code, debug, design - do whatever it takes to ship the product to production.
* Experience building and operating large-scale systems. Experience running production services in public clouds.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development.
* A self starter with the ability to work effectively in teams. Proactively identifying the symptoms of technical issues and reason about their causes is needed. This will be followed by fixing the root causes.
* Timely shipping of deliverables; being able to trade-off short term technical decisions with the long term. Move fast, build in increments, and iterate. A sense of urgency, a mindset towards achieving results, and excellent prioritization skills.
* Ability to influence the team, peers and upper management in technology decisions using effective communication and collaborative techniques
* Strong mentorship track record, guiding the team in building out complex systems, and helping them in their professional development.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience. Understanding of various technologies, programming paradigms and frameworks is needed. Ability to be pragmatic and trade off their usage in production is essential.
* Ability to take on intense customer production issues on-call; debugging and mitigating them will be needed. This requires patient log and metrics analysis with solid reasoning to nail the issue.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Advisor / Senior Solution Architect to

serve as a senior individual contributor and technical subject matter expert across strategic

customer engagements.

This is a hands-on role that spans both the sales and delivery lifecycle. The successful

candidate will lead technical solutioning, build critical components, resolve complex

implementation challenges, and remain accountable for the technical quality and successful

delivery of assigned customer solutions.

ownership. The individual will also mentor the broader technical team and help strengthen

delivery capability, standards, and execution quality.

* Lead the end-to-end technical solution for strategic and enterprise customer engagements
* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable applications and workflows
* Design and build complex low-code applications, workflows, integrations, data models, reports, and automation components
* Develop prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and reusable components
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex functional, technical, integration, performance, and security issues
* Establish development standards, reusable patterns, and implementation best practices

* Take ownership of technical escalations, working directly with internal teams and customers to resolve them

* Lead technical discovery workshops covering business processes, systems, integrations, and security requirements
* Build proof-of-concepts and prototypes to validate proposed solutions
* Contribute to proposals, statements of work, effort estimates, and implementation roadmaps
* Communicate platform capabilities, limitations, and delivery risks clearly to customers

**Project & Engagement Support**

* Take ownership of selected customer projects or technical workstreams as needed
* Support project planning, milestone definition, risk tracking, and status reporting

Team Growth & Mentoring

* Mentor solution architects, technical consultants, and developers through pairing and hands-on coaching
* Create reusable solution patterns, development standards, templates, and technical documentation

Required Experience

* Significant experience as a solution architect, technical architect, senior developer, or technical lead
* Strong hands-on experience building enterprise applications on low-code/no-code platforms such as Kissflow, Microsoft Power Platform, OutSystems, Mendix, Appian, ServiceNow, Salesforce Platform, or similar

* Strong application development experience — workflow design, data modeling, business rules, UI, integrations, reporting, and automation

* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues through testing, deployment, and production stabilization
* Experience contributing to proposals, statements of work, estimates, and implementation plans
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills — able to work with business stakeholders, IT teams, and senior customer leaders
* Experience mentoring technical team members while remaining an individual contributor

title: Associate / Specialist, Software Technology
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership**

* Drive technical discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation strategies for customer-facing software features and platform capabilities.
* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, production-grade software using C#, C++, Python/Java.
* Provide technical leadership for complex software initiatives while influencing engineering direction across teams.
* Evaluate and adopt modern software engineering practices, frameworks, development tools, and AI-assisted productivity solutions where appropriate.
* Contribute to software architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical roadmaps.

**Software Development & System Engineering**

* Develop deep technical expertise in LS-SWIFT inspection system software and associated workflows.
* Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, support, and continuous improvement.
* Debug and resolve complex issues across multi-process, multi-threaded, and multi-system software environments spanning Windows and Linux platforms.
* Design scalable, reliable, maintainable, and performant software systems that meet demanding product and customer requirements.
* Acquire and apply domain knowledge related to semiconductor defect inspection and inspection system workflows.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with global engineering teams across multiple geographies.
* Work effectively with systems, hardware, applications, manufacturing, service, and marketing teams throughout product development and deployment.
* Support product releases, customer escalations, field issues, and continuous product improvement efforts.
* Act as a technical integrator across teams to help drive successful product execution and divisional objectives.
* Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and engineering best practices.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Leverage AI productivity tools and modern engineering approaches to improve development efficiency and product quality.
* Identify opportunities for technical innovation, automation, and architecture improvements.
* Promote engineering excellence through robust design, code quality, testing, and maintainability practices.

**Travel**

* Travel to KLA and customer sites globally as required to support product development, deployment, customer engagement, and technology advancement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with C++ and Python development.
* Experience working in Linux environments.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, high-performance computing (HPC), or large-scale software platforms.
* Experience with AI productivity and development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar technologies.
* Experience developing software for semiconductors, industrial automation, instrumentation, manufacturing, or other complex engineering domains.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and drive execution across organizational boundaries.

**Desired Attributes**

* Strong ownership mindset and accountability.
* Ability to influence and lead through technical expertise.
* Passion for solving challenging engineering problems.
* Continuous learner with curiosity for emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Collaborative team player capable of working effectively across global organizations.
* Ability to energize teams and drive outcomes in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in BE / BTech / MS / MCA / MTech in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines.
* 10+ years of software development experience delivering complex software products.
* Strong expertise in C# and .NET application development.
* Strong software design, architecture, and object-oriented programming skills.
* Strong debugging and root-cause analysis capabilities in complex software environments.
* Solid understanding of Windows internals and .NET runtime concepts.
* Thorough knowledge of software engineering principles, SDLC, and software quality practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in global cross-functional teams.

**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

* Develop a reusable monitoring framework so new or refreshed scorecards can be onboarded quickly. Target operational dashboards within one week of model go-live, with outcome-based measures becoming available as repayment cohorts mature.

* Implement monitoring views for underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending and other assigned models. Support component and stacked-score views, product segments and model-version comparisons.

* Work with DS and Risk to define and implement Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, calibration, deciles, approval rates and bad rates. Capture agreed cohort, numerator, denominator and outcome-maturity rules rather than hard-coding ambiguous definitions.

* Separate input and score monitoring available at launch from performance metrics that require matured outcomes. Clearly label reporting windows, sample sizes, data freshness and insufficient-data conditions.

* Connect to BigQuery and approved data sources using efficient SQL and reusable data-access layers. Use pre-aggregation, caching and controlled refreshes to keep dashboards responsive and query costs manageable.

* Build visibility into partner coverage, missingness, API failures and score-range changes. Implement agreed threshold alerts and exception views with enough detail for teams to investigate.

* Deploy and maintain dashboards on the internal web server with IT, including service configuration, dependencies, logging and health checks. Integrate enterprise authentication and appropriate access controls for sensitive lending data.

* Reconcile dashboard results to independently checked SQL or DS calculations. Use tests, code review and user acceptance testing to prevent misleading metrics, filter behaviour or exports.

* Use approved AI coding tools where useful; review generated code and validate logic before release. Maintain version control, technical documentation and a prioritized backlog with users.

* Migrate and retire legacy BI (Power BI) dashboards as the Python stack matures, so refresh cycles are no longer constrained by the old setup.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 2 to 5 years of relevant Python dashboard, analytical application or web development experience, with examples of applications deployed for business users.

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical development experience.

* Strong Python and SQL skills, including pandas and experience building interactive applications with Dash and Plotly or a comparable Python web framework.

* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, callback or application state management, APIs and debugging web applications.

* Experience connecting dashboards to databases, validating calculated metrics, managing performance and maintaining production applications.

* Practical knowledge of Git, testing, Linux-based deployment, authentication and authorization. Ability to work with IT on secure internal hosting.

* Ability to clarify business metric definitions, present data accurately and collaborate with analysts, Data Scientists and Risk users.

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications:**

* Prior lending or credit risk scorecard monitoring experience, including Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, vintage analysis, deciles and matured bad-rate reporting.

* Experience with GCP and BigQuery, query optimization, caching, scheduled data refreshes and monitoring multiple model versions.

* Experience with enterprise SSO, role-based access, Docker, reverse proxies or deployment through CI/CD.

* Experience using AI-assisted development productively while retaining code review, tests, data protection and calculation validation.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A reusable dashboard framework makes monitoring available quickly after go-live and supports frequent scorecard refreshes.

* Metrics reconcile to agreed definitions, with clear maturity, freshness and sample-size information.

* Dashboards remain responsive, secure and useful for identifying degradation and directing investigation.

**Who are we looking for?**

We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.

* Willingness to go the extra mile for success.

* Energetic and lively, and street smart.

* As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.

* Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.

**About Tonik:**

We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. We create better financial products for the world by encouraging inclusivity through simplifying processes, reducing costs, improving transparency, and embracing flexibility to empower more people with unique financial needs. All these are on the most secure mobile banking platform. To enable this, innovation is woven into the DNA of our company. We do not just search for the best talent, but for people who seek to challenge the status quo and are passionate about transforming the impossible into reality.

Tonik (www.tonikbank.com) is the first digital-only neo bank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment, and card products to consumers on a highly secure digital banking platform. The neo bank operates based on the first private digital bank license issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Tonik is led by a team of retail finance veterans who have previously built and scaled multiple retail banks and fintechs across the global emerging markets. It is backed by top international venture capital funds. Tonik operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai, and Kyiv.

Our Data team works with Risk, Product, Technology and business teams to improve lending decisions and customer outcomes through reliable data, analytics and machine learning.

title: Software Development Engineer - 3
description:

* Contribute to improving developer workflows, tooling and automation.

title: Tech Team Lead
description:

www.allsec.ai

**About Allsec AI**

Allsec AI is an AI-native, digital-first, omni-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome-led services that eliminate traditional contact Centre inefficiencies.

**About This Role**

This is a founding engineering hire. You will be joining a pre-revenue, product-stage company with no existing engineering team in place,
*which means you will be responsible for taking our base demo product and building it into a production-grade platform.*

You will work in close collaboration with a US-based Technical Consultant who will provide architectural direction and high-level technical guidance. For day-to-day operations, delivery execution, and team coordination, you will report to the India Operational Head.

As the company scales, you will build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and own the India engineering operations end to end. If you are looking for a role where every decision you make has direct, visible impact.

**Reporting Structure**

* **Technical guidance, architecture direction, and product vision:**
  US-based Technical Consultant
* **Operational reporting, delivery accountability, and day-to-day coordination:**
  India Operational Head

**Key Responsibilities**

***Foundation & Architecture***

* Inherit, extend, and scale the existing technology stack (backend, frontend, DevOps, data pipelines, and ML/AI systems) building on a working demo product toward a production-ready platform.
* Establish production-grade engineering standards, tooling, and development processes, taking the codebase from demo quality to enterprise-ready.
* Define and own a scalable architecture for real-time, high-volume CX operations.

***Product & Infrastructure***

* Own and evolve the existing multi-cloud infrastructure (Digital Ocean, Azure, GCP) improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Extend and optimise existing integrations across multiple LLM providers, STT/TTS systems, AI agents, NLP pipelines, and vector databases.
* Ensure system observability, security, redundancy, and performance from day one.

***Team Building***

* As the first engineering hire, identify and help recruit subsequent technical team members.
* Mentor and develop engineers as the team scales; enforce best practices and foster technical excellence.
* Contribute actively to hiring decisions and help shape the engineering culture of the organisation.

***Collaboration & Stakeholder Management***

* Translate technical direction from the US-based Technical Consultant into executable roadmaps.
* Collaborate with CX implementation and QA functions to align technology with delivery operations.
* Actively participate in architectural decisions and long-term technical planning.

**Requirements**

* 6–10 years of total experience, with at least 1 year in a tech or team lead capacity.
* Deep experience with one or more full-stack frameworks (e.g., Node.js + React, Django + Vue, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of AI/ML model development and deployment – LLMs, transformers, RAG pipelines.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (Digital Ocean, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), and LLM APIs.
* Hands-on experience integrating and managing multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) alongside STT and TTS systems in production or near-production environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and scalable microservices.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and build things without an established team or process around you.
* Good communication skills — you will primarily interface with a global stakeholder in the US and an operations-focused leader in India.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with contact centre platforms, chatbots, or voice AI systems.
* Exposure to MLOps, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics dashboards.
* Prior start-up or early-stage product experience — particularly experience being the first or only engineer.
* Comfort working across time zones and with distributed teams.

**Why Join Allsec AI**

* You will be the architect of the technology foundation, i.e., you will take a working demo and turn it into the infrastructure that powers enterprise CX at scale; every architectural decision from here is yours.
* Work on cutting-edge AI/CX technology with global exposure and direct collaboration with the US technical leadership.
* Clear path to leading the India engineering organisation as the company scales.
* Competitive compensation and equity options available for the right candidate.

**Contact**

If you think this role excites you, please send your resumes to
**careers@allsec.ai**
&
**hr@allsec.ai**

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.
  
  
Innovation
  
  
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.
  
  
Opportunity
  
  
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.
  
  
As a Support Engineer, you will build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like in-house Applications and external aplications ), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for crunching and providing support for petabytes of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.

Very successful team that has developed a reputation of delivering results within Amazon.
  
  
We regularly research new technologies and invest for the future of our scalability

Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.

* Provide support of incoming tickets, including extensive troubleshooting tasks, with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services

* Develop tools to aid operations and maintenance

* Experience scripting in modern program languages
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of web services, distributed systems, and web application development
* Experience troubleshooting & maintaining hardware & software RAID
* Experience with REST web services, XML, JSON

description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
We're seeking an exceptional Data Platform Engineer to shape the strategic direction and architecture of our data infrastructure. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you'll co-own the overall platform architecture, set technical standards across the entire Data Engineering organization, and drive initiatives that directly impact our data strategy. You'll be a force multiplier—inspiring teams, mentoring senior engineers, and making architectural decisions that affect how the entire organization builds and operates data systems. We are in the midst of transforming our legacy infrastructure into a modern cloud-first platform, and you'll be instrumental in leading this technical evolution.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Strategic Platform Leadership
  
  

* Co-own and evolve the overall data platform architecture across all domains
* Guide the technical vision for the entire Data Engineering organization
* Drive platform initiatives that directly support the company's data strategy
* Lead the modernization of legacy systems while ensuring business continuity
* Identify and solve problems that span the entire Data Engineering org before they impact delivery
* Set the bar for excellence and serve as an inspiration across all engineering teams

Architecture & Technical Excellence
  
  

* Design and drive implementation of highly scalable platform architectures for multi-TB+ daily workloads
* Author and sign off on all RFCs and technical specifications that touch your domain(s)
* Define best practices and patterns that become standard across the organization
* Build self-service infrastructure that empowers hundreds of data consumers while maintaining reliability
* Design event-driven, real-time data architectures using Kafka and stream processing at scale
* Contribute to any codebase across the organization, setting quality standards through exemplary code

Platform Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Architect comprehensive Infrastructure as Code strategies and GitOps frameworks
* Design enterprise-grade security frameworks including encryption, zero-trust access controls, and compliance
* Establish SLAs/SLOs for critical platform services and drive observability strategy
* Lead complex incident response, conduct thorough post-mortems, and implement systemic improvements
* Drive platform reliability and performance optimization initiatives

Influence & Enablement
  
  

* Mentor IC9 and IC10 engineers, accelerating their technical growth and impact
* Collaborate across the entire Engineering organization as a thought partner
* Interact with executives and external stakeholders as a domain expert
* Democratize data access by empowering more teams to contribute to the data stack safely
* Identify hiring gaps and help define interview panels for critical technical roles
* Actively participate in and contribute to Data Engineering communities (conferences, Stack Overflow, vendor forums)

What You Bring
  
  
Deep Technical Expertise
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in SQL, Python, and at least one additional programming language
* Demonstrated mastery of object-oriented design and software engineering principles
* Deep expertise with databases across paradigms: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, Oracle, DynamoDB, MongoDB
* Extensive Kafka ecosystem expertise: cluster management, Debezium, schema registry, Connect frameworks, stream processing
* Advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes and Docker at scale
* Expert knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures

Platform Engineering Mastery
  
  

* Proven track record architecting platforms processing multi-TB daily workloads
* Experience designing and operating systems supporting hundreds of concurrent users
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud architectures, and scalability patterns
* Expert-level experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Jaeger)
* Mastery of data orchestration platforms like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster
* Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data systems while ensuring zero business disruption

Experience & Background
  
  

* 10-15+ years of professional experience in data platform engineering or related field
* Track record of leading complex, org-wide technical initiatives
* History of driving architectural decisions that scale across large organizations
* Experience in high-growth or large enterprise environments
* Deep expertise with both modern and legacy technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, Informatica, SSIS, Business Objects)

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Proven ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and domains
* Excellence in mentoring senior engineers and accelerating their growth
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to all levels
* Comfortable operating in high ambiguity and defining problems before solving them
* Track record of building collaborative relationships across engineering and business organizations
* Recognition as a thought leader in the Data Engineering community

Bonus Points
  
  

* Deep experience with modern data stack tools (dbt, Looker, etc.)
* Machine learning infrastructure and MLOps architecture expertise
* Contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects
* Published technical articles, conference talks, or thought leadership in data platforms
* Expert knowledge of data privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and implementation at scale

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 Days:**
Understand our architecture deeply, identify systemic opportunities and risks, and begin influencing key technical decisions. Establish yourself as a go-to expert in your domain(s).
  
  
**First Year:**
Drive at least one major architectural initiative that impacts the entire Data Engineering organization. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor to leadership and a mentor to senior engineers. Author multiple RFCs that set new standards.
  
  
**Ongoing:**
Continuously shape the technical direction of the organization, mentor the next generation of technical leaders, and maintain your position as one of the most knowledgeable experts in your domain(s) both internally and in the broader Data Engineering community.
  
  
Our Tech Stack
  
  
**Cloud & Infrastructure:**

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
