title: ServiceNow SecOps SIR - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber TechRisk - ServiceNow - SecOps – Security Incident Response — Consultant/Senior Consultant**
**Deloitte’s Cyber Risk Services**
help our clients to be secure, vigilant, and resilient in the face of an ever-increasing array of cyber threats and vulnerabilities. Our Cyber Risk practice helps organizations with the management of information and technology risks by delivering end-to-end solutions using proven methodologies and tools in a consistent manner. Our services help organizations address, in a timely manner, pervasive issues such as identity theft, data security breaches, data leakage, cyber security, and system outages across organizations of various sizes and industries with the goal of enabling ongoing, secure, and reliable operations across the enterprise.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Developer / Consultant with strong hands-on expertise in the Security Incident Response (SIR) module. The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of ServiceNow platform development experience, including at least 2 years focused specifically on implementing and managing Security Incident Response solutions. This role will be responsible for configuring, customizing, integrating, and automating the ServiceNow SIR lifecycle to support incident intake, triage, investigation, containment, remediation, and reporting.
  
  
**Work you will do**
As a
**Consultant / Senior Consultant**
, you would be expected to perform the following activities:
  
  

* Well versed with the application deployment and configuration baselines, and understanding of how the application environment operates in a secure environment and how exceptions are handled during operations.
* Facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to continuously improve the monitoring, management, and reliability of the service.
* Define the architecture and design elements for the implementation of ServiceNow SecOps solution including design data/object models, technical workflow diagrams, access control models, and integration patterns.
* Understand the business requirement and define & document epics, user stories, create UI mock-ups, and have a roll-up-the-sleeves approach to make things happen.
* Facilitate ServiceNow training and support teams on complex system configuration.
* Collaborate with clients to resolve business problems by translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
* Be responsible for end-to-end application design, workflow configurations, and customizations.
* Demonstrate good judgment and a pragmatic approach to delivering a solution that optimizes architecture activities across company needs, business constraints, and technological realities.

**Key Responsibilities (Security Incident Response)**

* Configure and administer ServiceNow Security Incident Response including security incident categories, playbooks, assignment rules, severity/priority models, SLAs, notifications, and response tasking.
* Design and support incident intake and triage workflows from multiple security sources such as SIEM, SOAR, threat intelligence, email security, EDR/XDR, vulnerability tools, and manual submissions.
* Integrate and maintain ingestion from security tools into the ServiceNow SIR application and validate data mapping, transformation logic, schedules, deduplication, and error handling.
* Build and maintain automations using Flow Designer / Integration Hub for enrichment, routing, approvals, escalations, containment support, evidence gathering, and closure activities.
* Configure incident lifecycle processes covering detection, analysis, triage, investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
* Partner with SOC, IR, IT Ops, app owners, and resolver groups to coordinate response workflows, manage dependencies, and ensure timely incident remediation.
* Define and publish dashboards / KPIs in ServiceNow for incident aging, MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, incident trends, severity distribution, and analyst workload.
* Support governance through audit-ready evidence, documentation, runbooks, access controls, and change / release management.
* Enable linkage between security incidents, vulnerable items, change records, problems, and CMDB CIs to improve traceability and operational response.
* Support development of response playbooks and standard operating procedures aligned to enterprise incident management and cyber response requirements.

**Optional Responsibilities (Vulnerability Response)**
Support integration points between Vulnerability Response and SIR, including creation of security incidents from exploited or high-risk vulnerabilities when needed.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* 3-10 years of ServiceNow experience (Admin/Developer/Platform).
* Hands-on experience implementing or operating ServiceNow Security Incident Response.
* Strong understanding of the security incident management lifecycle and SOC / IR operating processes.
* Experience with CMDB / asset data concepts and how they affect SIR accuracy, ownership, prioritization, and routing.
* Working knowledge of integrations (REST / API; MID Server where applicable) and automation (Flow Designer).
* Understanding incident prioritization, case handling, escalation models, and response coordination across stakeholders.

**Preferred / Nice To Have**

* ServiceNow CSA (Mandatory), CAD and CIS-SIR/SecOps-related CIS-certifications.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with SIEM / SOAR / EDR platforms.
* Scripting (ServiceNow JavaScript), performance tuning, and large-scale data ingestion.

**Core Skills**
ServiceNow SIR, SecOps, CMDB, Flow Designer / Integration Hub, integrations, reporting / dashboards, security incident lifecycle, stakeholder coordination, communication, and presentation.
  
  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in information technology or related field

**Location:**

* Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

The Senior Reconciliation Developer – Assistant Vice President (AVP / C12) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for the end-to-end design, development, configuration, and optimization of enterprise-grade data reconciliations and automated control pipelines.
  
  
Operating with a high level of technical autonomy, the incumbent drives reconciliation engineering across high-throughput transaction processing systems, general ledger architectures, and centralized data distribution platforms. The role serves as a key technical subject matter expert (SME) delivering robust risk controls, automated break classification logic, and scalable data pipelines for strategic initiatives including enterprise finance automation, Target Operating Model (TOM) expansion across Capital Markets, and mandatory control onboarding for 200+ critical application feeds.
  
  
Hybrid Schedule: 2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.
  
  
End-to-End Rule Build & Configuration: Design, build, test, and deploy complex multi-way matching algorithms, tolerance rules, and automated adjustment logic on enterprise reconciliation engines (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or proprietary enterprise matching engines).
  
  
Break Classification & Exception Handling: Engineer automated break classification and triage models to categorize discrepancies, assign break ownership, and accelerate root-cause analysis.
  
  
Scalable Data Pipeline Development: Develop and optimize high-throughput data extraction, transformation, and ingestion pipelines using Python (Advanced), SQL (Advanced), and Apache Spark / PySpark for large-scale financial and transactional datasets.
  
  
Technical Specification & BRD Translation: Partner with business analysts, operations teams, and product owners to translate Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) into detailed technical designs, data mapping specifications, and schema definitions.
  
  
Data Sourcing & Lineage Verification: Validate data integrity, provenance, and transformation logic from upstream Systems of Record (SoRs) into central data distribution hubs and analytical repositories.
  
  
Backlog Remediation Execution: Systematically analyze, develop, and deploy automated reconciliation solutions to clear active request backlogs (340+ scheduled and ad-hoc requests).
  
  
DevOps & Containerized Deployment: Package and deploy services utilizing Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift container platforms; maintain automated CI/CD build and test pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitLab).
  
  
Audit, Risk & Control Adherence: Ensure all built reconciliations satisfy internal audit, risk management, and regulatory control mandates as a required supervisory control mechanism.
  
  
Technical Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the go-to technical authority on reconciliation logic, data schemas, and pipeline performance for peer developers, QA analysts, and business partners.
  
  
Stakeholder Alignment: Actively liaise with upstream data providers, downstream consumers, operations specialists, and enterprise architecture leads to resolve data friction and ensure delivery milestones are met.
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Financial Technology, or a related quantitative field.
* 6–8+ years of hands-on software development, data engineering, or reconciliation systems configuration experience in Financial Services / Capital Markets.
* Proven track record as a senior individual contributor delivering complex, business-critical technical solutions independently.
* Python (Advanced): Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, data processing, script automation, REST/gRPC API development.
* SQL (Advanced): Complex joins, CTEs, analytical window functions, query execution plan optimization across relational and cloud data warehouses.
* Interoperability: Working knowledge of Java, Scala, or C# for enterprise microservices integration.

You will work directly alongside Principal Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineering Managers to architect, evaluate, and scale distributed systems on modern cloud platforms. This role is built for a senior-level developer with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep cloud and distributed systems experience, and a passion for system design, data modeling, and technical leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Architectural Design & Technical Leadership**

* Assist in drafting architectural blueprints, tech stack evaluation documents, and Architecture Decision
* Perform trade-off analyses balancing performance, maintainability, security, scalability, and operational costs across cloud services and codebases.
* Help define and enforce coding standards, API specifications (REST/gRPC/GraphQL), and design patterns across delivery teams.

**2. Hands-on Engineering & Prototyping**

  **Python**
  or equivalent modern languages).

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Integration**

* Architect resilient, highly available cloud applications on
  **AWS**
  or
  **Azure**
  using microservices, serverless, and containerized topologies.
* Collaborate with DevOps engineers to establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC), continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and deployment strategies (Canary, Blue/Green).
* Integrate full-stack observability (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) into software architecture from inception.

**4. Data Modeling & System Design**

* Design efficient relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) schemas optimized for read/write access patterns, storage efficiency, and data integrity.
* Implement event-driven and streaming architectures using message brokers (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Azure Event Grid).

**5. SDLC Execution & Engineering Mentorship**

* Champion the end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)—from threat modeling and capacity planning to post-launch monitoring.
* Conduct high-impact code and design reviews, mentoring mid-level and junior engineers on clean architecture, principles, and system resilience.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Software Development:**
  7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience using
  **Python**
  or similar languages (Go, Java, C#).
* **Distributed Computing:**
  Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems. Strong understanding algorithms, caching strategies (Redis/Memcached), load balancing, and fault-tolerance patterns (Circuit Breakers, Bulkheads).
* **Cloud Platforms:**
  3+ years of building and deploying production workloads on
  **AWS**
  (e.g., EKS/ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS, S3) or
  **Azure**
  (e.g., AKS, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL).
* **Data Modeling:**
  Proficiency in designing data schemas) and database migrations, and query optimization.
* **DevOps & IaC:**
  Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep), and automated pipeline tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
* **Full SDLC Mastery:**

**Behavioral & Aspirant Attributes**

* **Architecture Mindset:**

* **Communication:**
  Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write concise technical documentation.
* **Continuous Learner:**

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Books
description:
**Description**
Amazon Kindle is a revolutionary reading device and one of the most innovative devices at Amazon.
  
  
Our Organization is looking for an inventive and technically skilled Software Development Engineer to join our diverse team at the forefront of delighting millions of readers around the world. We build the next generation reading experience. Our team works backwards from customers by understanding their needs to design and implement solutions that deliver an immersive reading experience across a wide variety of devices, genres, and formats.
  
  
We are looking for full-stack Software Development Engineers who enjoys building high quality software that touches millions of customers. Those who seek a challenge, are eager to learn, and want to make a impact on global customers should apply.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Software Engineer will contribute to the definition, development, integration, test, documentation, and support of Java, C++ and ReactNative software across multiple digital surfaces for Kindle Readers and Applications. This hands-on position will engage your engineering capabilities and technical knowledge of software development while developing experience successfully planning, organizing, and conducting software development projects in a dynamic environment.
  
  

* Responsible for the architecture of software solutions, working with and improving on current limitations and compatibilities between subsystems, building new concepts and methodology, and the development of major routines and utilities.
* Designing and Building new features that are highly performant
* Preparation of technical requirements and software design specifications.
* Understanding the internals of graphics subsystems.
* Instilling best practices for software development and documentation, making sure designs meet requirements, and delivering high quality software on tight schedules.

A day in the life
  
  
In the course of a typical day, an SDE in Amazon team can:
  
  

* ship and review C++, ReactNative or Java for reading features on Kindle E-Reader
* collaborate with peers, product owners, UX designers and partner tech teams on architecture and design of reading features.
* adapt the customer experience for the next generation of Kindle E-Reader devices focusing on operational excellence, monitoring the team's code deployment pipelines and dashboards
* root cause issues and propose solutions
* train new team-mates on how E-Reader and Kindle Application software is constructed, how it operates, how secure it is, and how it fits into the bigger picture.

**About The Team**
We own the design, architecture, and implementation of a surface to enable reading innovation across file formats and operating systems. Our software supports Kindle customers on all major mobile surfaces and Kindle devices. Our engineers enjoy working as a team and welcome the opportunity to lead whenever possible.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience programming with C++.
* Experience programming with C++.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Responsibilities: - Build the canonical billing and entitlement ledger design and implement an append-only, journals-as-truth Postgres schema (orders, signed payments ledger, dated entitlement grants, gap-free per-entity invoice numbering) where all state is a derived view and every entitlement traces to a paid order line. - Own the full subscription lifecycle in code: purchase, renewal, resubscription, upgrade/downgrade/switch, proration, trials, cancellation, and lapse across both Stripe and Razorpay, ending the renewal/resubscription bugs that lose money and entitlements today. - Build the gateway ingest pipeline: idempotent, replay-safe webhook handling for Stripe, Razorpay, and Apple notifications, normalized into the ledger with dead-letter handling and reconciliation that proves the gateway and our books agree every day. - Handle the hard money paths: refunds, chargebacks/disputes, credits, and partial/zero-amount settlements, with signed lines that allocate the gateway-charged amount correctly and never double-count. - Produce clean financial and entitlement data and the views that feed accounting close (revenue recognition, multi-entity GST/IGST and US tax, deferred revenue), exchange reporting (CME and Indian exchanges), and conversion/retention analytics. - Own the user billing surface end-to-end: the user cabinet and checkout (TypeScript/Astro/React) where customers buy, upgrade, manage, and cancel so the experience and the ledger never disagree. - Migrate the live business safely, backfill historical payments with documented confidence tiers, run the new system in parallel against the legacy CouchDB account model, prove reconciliation is clean, and then cut over read and write paths region by region. Requirements: - 6-10 years of backend engineering, with deep Go and strong relational data modeling and SQL; you design schemas that stay correct under concurrency and scale. - You have built or rebuilt payments, subscriptions, and ledgers end-to-end: payment-gateway integration, idempotent webhooks, the subscription lifecycle (renewals, proration, upgrades, cancellation, and dunning), and refunds and disputes. This is the core of the job, not an adjacent skill. - The full money-systems depth that surrounds a ledger is required, not optional: reconciliation (gateway books), revenue recognition and tax (e. g., GST/IGST, ASC 606 or equivalent), financial/exchange reporting, and event-sourced/append-only ledger design (journals-as-truth, derived state, signed entries). - Experience building or owning a B2B product where billing and entitlement complexity is real (metering, plans/add-ons, multi-tenant or partner billing). GoCharting also runs a /b2b and white-label surface. - SQL fluency to interrogate money data yourself; you can find the row that explains the discrepancy, not just file a ticket. - Comfortable in a TypeScript/React frontend to own the user cabinet and checkout end-to-end (you don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you ship the surface that touches your ledger). - In-person in our Chennai office; this role works too closely with Finance, the CTO, and the live money flow to be remote. Nice-to-Haves: - Prior fintech or trading domain is genuinely good to have, but not required: billing correctness is domain-agnostic, and the market's context is learnable on the job - EU VAT/OSS, multi-entity, or multi-currency billing experience. - AWS Cognito / identity at scale, or prior work untangling a legacy data model during a live migration. - Experience standing up reconciliation, finance-close, or revenue-reporting pipelines that accountants actually trusted. - Top-tier Indian institution (IIT/NIT/IIM) nice-to-have, not a gate. Company Summary GoCharting is a web-native, multi-asset order flow trading platform trusted by more than 2 million registered traders globally. The platform brings professional-grade trading tools, including footprint and cluster charts, depth of market (DOM), volume profile, market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance analytics, time and sales, options analytics, alerts, scripting, broker connectivity, and real-time market data into a browser-based product with companion mobile apps. GoCharting serves active retail and professional traders across futures, options, stocks, forex, crypto, and commodities through a freemium SaaS model with premium subscriptions and market data add-ons. GoCharting began with a trader's obsession, an open-source library, and a GitHub conversation across two continents. Why Join Us GoCharting is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. GoCharting is an async-friendly team of engineers, traders, and product builders on a mission to give every trader on earth access to institutional-grade tools. We're backed, growing fast, and looking for exceptional people!

['Go', 'PostgreSQL', 'Postgres', 'SQL', 'ledger', 'payments', 'subscriptions']

title: Principal Architect - Payments & Ledger
description:
YouTrip is the leading and fastest-growing multi-currency payment platform in Asia Pacific. In 2018, we pioneered the region's first multi-currency digital wallet. Now, YouTrip is the #1 multi-currency digital wallet trusted by millions across the region, processing over US$15 billion in total payment value annually. 

Our consumer and business propositions - YouTrip and YouBiz - empower individuals and businesses with inclusive, accessible, and affordable financial solutions. YouTrip has raised over US$110 million to date, including its recent Series B round led by global venture capital firm Lightspeed Venture Partners—underscoring strong investor confidence in its mission to transform digital financial services across the Asia Pacific. 

Recognised as World Economic Forum's Global Innovator 2025, CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024), and LinkedIn's Top Startup (2024, 2023), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.

Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions. 

Job Description: Principal Architect, Payments & Ledger

You'll own the architectural direction for money movement end to end: multi-currency wallets and balances, the core ledger, card issuing and authorisation, in-app FX, overseas transfers and payouts, treasury and pre-funding, settlement and reconciliation, and the shared platform services underneath them. Your remit covers both YouTrip (consumer) and YouBiz (business), across every market we operate in.

Responsibilities:

* The Ledger - Double-entry design, chart of accounts, sub-ledger boundaries, immutability and correction rules, multi-currency representation, precision and rounding policy, and how balances are derived or stored. You'll define how we handle authorisation holds, reversals, partial and incremental captures, refunds, FX revaluation and unreconciled positions, and you'll be able to explain and defend those choices to Finance, auditors and regulators
* Money movement correctness -  Idempotency, exactly-once outcomes on top of at-least-once messaging, clear state machines for every transaction type, and well-defined failure, retry, timeout and compensation paths. For every integration, the question "what happens if the partner succeeds and we fail?" should have a written answer that you own
* Card issuing - Architecture for authorisation, clearing and settlement as a Mastercard Principal Member, including real-time authorisation on the scheme's critical path, stand-in processing, authorisation expiry, disputes and chargebacks, tokenisation for Apple Pay and Google Pay, virtual and physical card lifecycle, and the strict latency and availability targets that come with it
* FX and multi-currency wallets - Rate sourcing, quoting and rate locking, spread and exposure management, in-app currency exchange across our wallet currencies, and pre-funding and liquidity models that keep customers' balances safe and available
* Cross-border transfers - Corridor architecture, payout rail integrations (local real-time rails, bank transfers, SWIFT and partner networks), pre-funding and nostro design, and sanctions and AML screening built in as a core design constraint, not an afterthought
* Reconciliation and settlement - We treat reconciliation as an architecture problem, not an operations task. You'll design systems where breaks are rare, spotted within minutes, and traceable to a clear cause, across multiple time zones, currencies and partners
* Non-functional requirements - Latency, throughput, availability and cost as design targets with numbers attached. Clear, written decisions on where eventual consistency is acceptable and where it isn't. Recovery, replay and backfill as built-in capabilities
* Standards and technical judgement - Engineering and coding standards, architecture reviews for significant changes, and architecture documentation that engineers actually build from. You'll write decision records that capture the reasoning and the options rejected, and keep them current
* Partners and vendors - Technical evaluation and ongoing oversight of card processors, scheme connectivity, banking and settlement partners, FX liquidity providers, payout partners, KYC and screening vendors, and core infrastructure. You'll know their systems' failure modes as well as their own architects do
* Growing technical leaders - You'll mentor tech leads and senior engineers from day one and lead mostly through influence. As the function matures, you'll build and lead a small architecture group

**Requirements**

* Deep payments and ledger experience (essential) - You've designed or substantially rebuilt a production financial ledger. You can speak from real experience about journal design, posting models, balance consistency and correction strategies, including what happens when they go wrong
* Card issuing expertise - Hands-on experience with card scheme integrations (ideally Mastercard), issuer processing, authorisation flows, clearing files, and disputes
* A builder, not just an advisor - You've written production code at scale, and your work sits behind systems that handled real traffic and real money. Your authority comes from having shipped
* Range from system to field level - You're equally comfortable designing distributed settlement flows and deciding the type and precision of a single amount field, often in the same week
* Regulated-environment fluency - Experience with safeguarding and customer fund segregation, payment and e-money licensing, data residency, auditability and technology risk requirements, ideally including MAS and other Asia Pacific regulators. You design ahead of regulatory and scheme changes instead of reacting to them
* Multi-market experience - You've built systems that operate across several countries, currencies and regulators at once
* Strong writing - Clear, structured, opinionated documents that remain useful long after the meeting ends. Documentation is part of the work, not a follow-up task
* Opinions you can defend - Clear positions on design patterns, standards and trade-offs, explained just as well to a new graduate as to the board
* Credibility with partners - You can tell when a vendor's recommendation serves them more than us, and you can make that case with evidence
* Experience with Golang, event-driven architectures and cloud-native infrastructure is a plus

What This Role Is Not

This isn't a diagramming role, and it isn't a review gate that approves other people's work without contributing to it. It's also not an engineering management role with large headcount or delivery ownership, though its influence is comparable. If you're looking to run a large organisation, we have other roles for that.

What You Can Expect From Us

* The chance to shape the core money platform of Asia Pacific's leading multi-currency wallet, used by millions of people and businesses
* Some of the most interesting payments challenges in the region, across multiple markets, currencies, partners and regulators
* A company that is committed to getting the architecture right, not just shipping fast
* A culture that values technical craft, direct feedback and getting things done

To Apply

If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Technical Lead Workday Platform
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**T**
****echnical Lead -Workday Platform****
We are seeking a highly skilled T
**echnical Lead -Workday Platform**
to join our global Workday Platform team. This role will primarily focus on Workday Integrations and Reporting, supporting enterprise-wide HR and Finance processes across multiple business functions, including Human Resources, Payroll, Employee Experience, Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Invoice-to-Cash (I2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R).
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in Workday integrations, reporting, and platform development, combined with strong stakeholder engagement skills and a commitment to governance, standardization, and continuous improvement. This role will partner closely with business, HR, Finance, and IT teams to design, build, support, and optimize Workday solutions while contributing to the ongoing evolution of the Workday platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Workday Integrations Development**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations using:
* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
* Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS)
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST APIs)
* Develop and maintain inbound and outbound integrations across Workday, Payroll, Finance, Benefits, Identity Management, and third-party applications.
* Configure and manage Integration System Users (ISUs), integration security, authentication methods, and middleware connectivity.
* Monitor integration performance, troubleshoot production issues, and implement scalable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
* Drive integration lifecycle activities including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

**Workday Reporting & Analytics**

* Design and develop Advanced, Matrix, BIRT, and operational reporting solutions to support business and operational requirements.
* Build dashboards, scheduled report deliveries, and self-service reporting capabilities for HR, Finance, Payroll, and leadership stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain calculated fields and reporting frameworks that support enterprise reporting standards.
* Optimize report performance, usability, and data quality while ensuring governance and consistency.

**HCM & Financials Platform Support**

* Partner with business stakeholders supporting HCM and Financials business processes.
* Contribute to initiatives supporting Procure-to-Pay, Invoice-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report business functions.
* Collaborate with Finance teams to expand and support Workday Financials capabilities, including Financial Data Model (FDM) structures and reporting requirements.
* Assist with financial process automation, reporting enhancements, and integrations supporting procurement and financial operations.

**Platform Governance & Best Practices**

* Promote platform governance through documentation, standardization, naming conventions, reference ID management, and reusable design patterns.
* Maintain technical documentation for integrations, reports, data mappings, and support processes.
* Apply enterprise best practices for security, data governance, audit readiness, and operational support.
* Support ownership and accountability models through dedicated ISUs and integration governance frameworks.

**Workday Release & Continuous Improvement**

* Participate in Workday bi-annual release activities, including:
* Release note reviews
* Preview tenant testing
* Regression testing
* Evaluation of automatically enabled and opt-in features
* Assess impacts to integrations, reports, and business processes and coordinate implementation plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform efficiency, automation, and user experience.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, Employee Experience, IT, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.
* Participate in cross-functional project teams supporting new implementations, enhancements, and transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate effectively with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.
* Support flexible collaboration models to accommodate global stakeholder engagement.

**Mentorship & Knowledge Sharing**

* Mentor junior developers, analysts, and operational teams on Workday integrations, reporting, calculated fields, and platform best practices.
* Support knowledge transfer initiatives and promote self-service reporting capabilities within business functions.
* Contribute to team capability development through training, documentation, and peer coaching.

**Innovation & Productivity**

* Leverage modern productivity and AI-enabled tools to improve planning, analysis, testing, documentation, and operational efficiency.
* Participate in continuous learning and evaluation of emerging Workday technologies, testing tools, and platform capabilities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of Workday experience with strong emphasis on technical development.
* Proven hands-on expertise with:
* Workday Studio
* Core Connectors
* EIBs
* RaaS
* Workday Web Services (SOAP/REST)
* Middleware integrations
* ISU management
* Strong experience developing and supporting Workday reporting solutions, including:
* Advanced Reports
* Matrix Reports
* BIRT Reports
* Dashboards and scheduled reporting
* Experience supporting full project lifecycles including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across HR, Finance, Payroll, and IT organizations.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments and Jira-based project management processes.
* Demonstrated commitment to documentation, governance, and operational excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Workday Financials, including Financial Data Model (FDM) concepts and financial reporting requirements.
* Experience supporting Procure-to-Pay, Invoice-to-Cash, or Record-to-Report business processes.
* Familiarity with Workday Security concepts including role-based and user-based security groups.
* Exposure to Prism Analytics, Composite Reports, Kainos, Testmo, or other testing and automation platforms.
* Workday certifications in Integrations, Reporting, HCM, or Financials.
* Experience leveraging AI-enabled productivity tools such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, NotebookLM, or similar technologies.

**Success Profile**
The successful candidate will be a technically strong Workday professional who can quickly contribute across integrations and reporting while partnering effectively with global stakeholders. They will demonstrate strong ownership, collaboration, documentation discipline, and a continuous learning mindset while helping advance the organization's Workday HCM and Financials platform capabilities.
  
  
**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**

**About Genesys:**
Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. title: Internship Program 2026 - Build Your Career Through Real Project Experience
description:
**Job Description**
Launch Your Career with Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited
  
  
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
is inviting applications from
**2026 graduates**
and a limited number of
**2025 graduates**
for our
**2027 project expansion plans**
.
  
  
We are looking for passionate, self-motivated individuals who aspire to build a successful career by gaining practical industry experience through real-time software development and business projects.
  
  
**Internship Opportunities Are Available In The Following Departments**

* MERN Stack Development
* Software Testing (Manual & Automation)
* Executive Assistant
* Product Design (UI/UX)
* Human Resources (HR)
* DevOps
* IT Support

This internship is designed for candidates who believe that
**knowledge, practical exposure, discipline, and continuous improvement are the foundation of a successful career.**
Unlike conventional training programs, this is a
**real-time industry learning opportunity**
where interns gain hands-on experience by working alongside experienced professionals on live projects.
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
  
**This Internship Is Ideal For Candidates Who**

* Have graduated in 2026 or are selected from the 2025 graduate batch.
* Are interested in building a career in the ERP and business software domain.
* Are passionate about learning and building a long-term professional career.
* Are willing to learn through practical implementation rather than classroom training.
* Want genuine industry exposure through real-time projects.
* Are self-motivated and committed to continuous learning and improvement.
* Are willing to accept feedback and continuously improve their performance.
* Are prepared to demonstrate their knowledge and skills through practical work and assessments.
* Value knowledge, discipline, professional growth, and long-term career development.

**This program is not intended for candidates whose primary expectation is immediate stipend or salary.**
Our primary objective is to develop skilled professionals who are capable of building successful long-term careers through continuous learning, practical industry experience, discipline, and proven performance.
  
  
Who Should Not Apply?
  
  
Please carefully understand the nature of this opportunity before applying.
  
  
**Candidates Should Not Apply If They**

* Are not interested in the ERP domain or business software industry.
* Expect an immediate stipend or salary from the beginning of the internship.
* Are primarily looking for a paid internship rather than a performance-based learning opportunity.
* Are looking for an internship only to obtain a certificate.
* Are not willing to undergo strong assessments at every stage.
* Are not comfortable with performance-based continuation.
* Are looking only to complete the internship duration without focusing on learning and performance.
* Are not willing to continuously improve their knowledge and practical skills.
* Are not interested in proving their capabilities through actual work and performance.
* Are not interested in a potential long-term employment opportunity with the organization.
* Are unwilling to take ownership, accept feedback, maintain discipline, and demonstrate professional commitment.

Important
  
  
**This opportunity is not designed for candidates who are looking only for a certificate, immediate payment, or a short-term internship experience.**
**Certification is not guaranteed merely for joining or attending the program.**
This opportunity is for candidates who are genuinely willing to:
  
  
**Learn → Practice → Perform → Improve → Prove Themselves → Build a Career**
If you are genuinely interested in the ERP domain, willing to invest your time and effort in learning, and want to prove yourself through performance with the possibility of securing a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Nature of the Internship
  
  
This internship follows a
**Self-Learning with Industry Mentorship Model.**
**Candidates Will Be Expected To**

* Learn independently with guidance from mentors.
* Complete assigned learning modules and project tasks.
* Work on real client and internal projects.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Continuously improve technical and professional skills.
* Demonstrate discipline, professionalism, and accountability throughout the program.
* Accept feedback positively and implement improvements.
* Demonstrate consistent performance throughout the internship.

Success in this internship depends largely on the candidate's willingness to learn, adapt, take responsibility, and consistently perform.
  
  
Selection Process
  
  
Stage 1 – Five-Day Assessment Program
  
  
Before being admitted into the internship program, every applicant must successfully complete a
**5-working-day assessment**
.
  
  
During this assessment, candidates will be assigned practical tasks to evaluate not only technical aptitude but also professional qualities.
  
  
**The Evaluation Includes**

* Learning ability
* Problem-solving approach
* Discipline and punctuality
* Sincerity and commitment
* Professional ethics
* Ownership and accountability
* Communication skills
* Adaptability
* Consistency in task completion
* Overall suitability for the internship program

Only candidates who successfully complete this assessment will be offered internship positions.
  
  
Internship Structure and Stipend Eligibility
  
  
The internship will be for
**150 working days**
, divided into
**six blocks of 25 working days each**
.
  
  
Block Duration Stipend Blocks 1–3 75 working days
**No stipend**
Block 4 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 5 25 working days ₹5,000\* Block 6 25 working days ₹5,000\*
**Total**
**150 working days**
**Up to ₹15,000**
\*
  
  
Stipend eligibility is directly connected to the candidate's performance and successful progression through the internship blocks.
  
  
**Candidates Who Successfully Progress To**
**Block 4 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 5 → ₹5,000 stipend**
**Block 6 → ₹5,000 stipend**
will be eligible for the applicable stipend only after satisfying the required performance standards for the respective block.
  
  
The organization reserves the right to determine stipend eligibility based on the candidate's performance assessment.
  
  
Block-Wise Performance Assessment
  
  
At the end of
**every 25-working-day block**
, candidates will undergo a
**strict performance assessment**
.
  
  
**Each Assessment Will Evaluate**

* Technical learning progress
* Practical implementation skills
* Quality of work
* Discipline and attendance
* Professional behaviour
* Ownership of responsibilities
* Ability to improve based on feedback
* Team collaboration
* Communication
* Problem-solving ability
* Commitment towards career development
* Overall performance

**Candidates who successfully clear the assessment will be allowed to continue to the next block.**
Candidates who do not meet the required standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be allowed to progress to the next block.
  
  
Performance-Based Continuation
  
  
Continuation in the internship is
**entirely based on performance**
.
  
  
**Candidates Who Consistently Demonstrate**

* Learning capability
* Professional conduct
* Improvement mindset
* Discipline
* Accountability
* Positive attitude
* Technical and practical improvement
* Consistency
* Commitment to excellence

will continue through the internship program.
  
  
Candidates who fail to meet the expected standards at any stage may be discontinued from the internship without progressing to the next block.
  
  
**Completion of a particular number of days does not automatically qualify a candidate for the next block. Successful assessment is mandatory for progression.**
Employment Opportunity
  
  
Candidates who successfully complete
**all six internship blocks (150 working days)**
with
**strong, consistent, and proven performance**
will be considered for a
**Fresher employment opportunity**
with the organization.
  
  
**Candidates Who Demonstrate**

* Strong learning capability
* Consistent performance
* Better assessment ratings
* Technical and practical competency
* Professional discipline
* Ownership and accountability
* Positive attitude
* Adaptability
* Ability to contribute effectively to the organization

may offered a
**Fresher role with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA**
, subject to the organization's final assessment, available positions, and business requirements.
  
  
The employment opportunity is intended for candidates who successfully demonstrate strong performance and achieve the required assessment standards throughout the complete internship program.
  
  
Terms & Conditions
  
  
By applying for this internship, candidates acknowledge and agree to the following:
  
  

* Successful completion of the 5-working-day assessment is mandatory before joining the internship.
* The internship consists of six assessment blocks of 25 working days each, totaling 150 working days.
* The first three blocks, totaling 75 working days, are unpaid and no stipend will be provided during this period.
* Candidates must successfully clear the assessment of each block to continue to the subsequent block.
* Candidates who successfully progress to Blocks 4, 5, and 6 may be eligible for a stipend of ₹5,000 per block, subject to satisfactory performance and successful completion of the respective block.
* The maximum stipend payable during the final three blocks is ₹15,000.
* Stipend eligibility is performance-based and is not guaranteed merely by attendance or completion of the block.
* Candidates who fail to meet the required performance standards may be discontinued from the internship and will not be permitted to proceed to the next block.
* Candidates are expected to possess strong self-learning capability, discipline, professionalism, accountability, and a positive attitude towards continuous improvement.
* Candidates should remain fully focused on learning, performing, and building their careers throughout the internship.
* Any form of indiscipline, groupism, misconduct, unethical behaviour, misuse of company resources, or activities that negatively impact the learning environment will not be tolerated and may result in immediate discontinuation from the internship.
* Candidates are expected to maintain complete confidentiality regarding company information, projects, clients, intellectual property, and internal processes.
* Performance evaluations conducted by the organization shall be final and binding.
* Completion of the internship does not automatically guarantee employment.
* Candidates who successfully complete all six blocks with strong and consistently demonstrated performance may be considered for a Fresher position with a starting CTC of ₹1.8 LPA, subject to business requirements and available openings.
* Candidates who voluntarily discontinue the internship or whose internship is terminated due to unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or violation of company policies will not be eligible to receive an Internship Completion Certificate or Experience Certificate for the period served.
* Candidates seeking only a certificate, immediate stipend, or immediate salary should not apply for this program.
* Certification is not guaranteed merely based on joining or attending the internship.
* All decisions made by the organization regarding assessment results, continuation, discontinuation, stipend eligibility, certification, and employment shall be final.

Ready to Build Your Career?
  
  
**If You Are**

* Self-motivated
* Disciplined
* Passionate about learning
* Interested in the ERP domain
* Willing to work hard
* Willing to learn through practical experience
* Ready to undergo strict performance assessments
* Looking for genuine industry exposure
* Committed to building a long-term career
* Interested in proving yourself through performance

we encourage you to apply and begin your professional journey with
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
.
  
  
**Learn. Perform. Improve. Prove Yourself. Build Your Career.**
**Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Us.**
Important Information
  
  
Limited Vacancies
  
  
**Please Note:**
Internship positions are limited. Applications will be processed on a
**first-come, first-preference basis**
, subject to eligibility and successful completion of the selection process.
  
  
We encourage interested candidates to apply as early as possible.
  
  
Assessment & Internship Details
  
  
**Location:**
Office-Based
**(On-Premises only)**
**Office Address:**
Chromepet, Chennai
  
  
**Working Days:**
Monday to Friday
  
  
**Office Hours:**
9:30 AM – 7:30 PM
  
  
**Attendance:**
Continuous participation throughout both the Assessment and Internship is mandatory.
  
  
This internship is a full-time, office-based learning program. Candidates should ensure they can commit to the complete schedule before applying.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
If You Are Genuinely Interested In This Opportunity, Please Submit Your Application Along With Your Updated Resume And Provide Detailed Responses To The Following Questions
  
  
1️⃣ Why do you believe you are a suitable candidate for this internship?
  
  
Please explain your strengths, learning mindset, career aspirations, interest in the ERP domain, and why you feel you are the right fit for the selected role.
  
  
2️⃣ Confirmation of Interest
  
  
Kindly confirm that you have carefully read the
**Internship Program details, Stipend Structure, Terms & Conditions, and Performance Assessment Process**
, and that you are interested in participating in the
**5-Day Assessment Program**
followed by the internship, if selected.
  
  
3️⃣ Availability Confirmation
  
  
Please confirm that you are able to attend both the Assessment Program and the Internship continuously as per the organization's office location, working days, and office timings.
  
  
Important Notice
  
  
You may have come across this internship opportunity through various sources, including job portals, social media, WhatsApp groups, referrals, or other online platforms.
  
  
Regardless of where you learned about this opportunity,
**we strongly recommend that every applicant visit our official website, carefully read the complete Internship Program details, Terms & Conditions, Stipend Structure, and Assessment Process, and submit the application only through the official application process.**
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited does not charge any registration fee, training fee, security deposit, placement fee, or any other payment for this Internship Program.**
If anyone claims to represent the company and requests money or any form of payment in exchange for internship selection or employment, please treat it as fraudulent. We request all applicants to remain vigilant and avoid such scams.
  
  
Application Process
  
  
Due to the large number of applications we receive, we request all candidates to:
  
  

* Submit their application through our official website.
* Please wait for a response from our Recruitment Team. You will be contacted only if your profile is shortlisted for the next stage of the process.
* Avoid submitting multiple applications for the same opportunity.

Candidates who are shortlisted will be contacted by our HR team.
  
  
For quicker communication regarding your application, you may send a
**WhatsApp message**
to our
**official HR number**
after submitting your application through the website.
  
  
**Kindly do not make phone calls**
, as our recruitment team may not be able to answer individual application enquiries due to the high volume of applicants.
  
  
We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with candidates who are passionate about learning, growing, proving themselves through performance, and building a successful career with
**Gway Tech Solutions Private Limited**
.
  
  
**We are looking for individuals with the right attitude, discipline, integrity, willingness to learn, and commitment to prove themselves through performance. Skills can be developed; character and commitment define long-term success.**

title: WFM (UKG Pro/ Kronos / Boomi) - Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY- Global Delivery Services (GDS) – People Consulting (PC) - Work Force Management (WFM) – UKG WFM Boomi Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for
**Senior Consultants**
with expertise in
**Boomi integration**
development within
**UKG Pro Workforce Management**
to join the GDS PC team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading global professional services organisation whilst being instrumental in the growth of the GDS PC team.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and support end‑to‑end UKG Pro WFM integrations using the Boomi AtomSphere platform.
* Work across the full integration lifecycle including Discovery, Design, Configuration, Build, Testing, Knowledge Transfer, Migration, and Post‑Production Support involving third‑party systems.
* Implement API‑led and event‑driven integration patterns for both inbound and outbound interfaces.
* Perform data mapping, validation, transformation, and error handling across integrated systems to ensure data accuracy and stability.
* Analyse Boomi Process/Atom logs to diagnose integration issues, monitor system behaviour, and optimize workflows for performance and reliability.
* Ensure high quality, accuracy, and timeliness of all integration deliverables and technical documentation.
* Drive effective client communication and delivery cadence, collaborating closely with client stakeholders and project team members across global locations.
* Work on client engagements as part of a global distributed delivery team, coordinating across time zones and functions.
* Consistently deliver high‑quality outcomes to achieve strong client satisfaction and positive feedback from global project counterparts.
* Contribute to the development of thought leadership, collateral, tools, techniques, and methodologies to strengthen Workforce Management service offerings.
* Support and participate in EY practice initiatives and internal capability‑building efforts.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Demonstrates strong analytical capability with a structured approach to problem‑solving.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, take ownership, and work proactively in dynamic environments.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.
* Cross‑cultural awareness and sensitivity, comfortable working with global teams.
* High energy levels, agility, and adaptability in challenging delivery environments.
* High integrity and commitment to working in new and demanding environments.
* Open to national and international travel for client engagements, subject to EY and country‑specific travel advisory guidelines.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 6 - 9 years of relevant experience
* Minimum 4 years of experience in Workforce management (Time management, attendance, forecasting, scheduling, etc.) and Payroll consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Experience of working in a consulting environment on global client projects
* Boomi Professional Developer Certification/Badge
* Strong understanding of REST/SOAP APIs, web services, data mapping and ETL frameworks.
* Proficiency in Groovy/JavaScript within Boomi is highly desired.
* Well versed in API testing tools like PostMan

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Demonstrated technical proficiencies in UKG WFM; a practical/business driven approach to solving complex global Workforce Management client challenges
* Strong technical knowledge and experience of end-to-end Workforce Management process
* Analytical abilities and knowledge of Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Expertise in process mapping and documentation using Visio and other tools
* Expertise in creating SOP, process documentation and work instructions
* Ability to undertake Workforce Management process review and improvement activities including the identification of process efficiencies and control effectiveness.
* Exposure to work force transformation programs enabled by technology. Led or been part of a work stream in multi work stream transformation program
* Involved in policy review, current Workforce Management assessments, vendor selections, designing payroll processes and strategies at global level, global payroll implementation support

**What We Look For**

* Professionals who are independent, self-motivated, proactive, results-oriented and able to provide a high level of customer satisfaction through the delivery of world-class support services. Apart from day-to-day activities, the candidate is expected to be involved in strategic planning to grow the team.
* Technical experts with commercial acumen, relevant experiences and high degree of enthusiasm to adapt and learn in a fast-moving environment
* Professionals who are willing to work in an environment of continual professional development, drive to take on new responsibilities and projects and work experiences with clients across geographies

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

title: Solution Engineer
description:
**Your role**
**What You'll Be Doing**
Solution Engineer
  
  
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is seeking a Solutions Engineer for our Cross-Border division, within the Corporate Payments line of business department, located in Chennai, India.
**Reports to:**
Payment Solutions Manager (Chennai)
  
  
**About Corpay Cross-Border**
Corpay Cross-Border helps businesses move money globally, manage currency risk, and streamline international payments. Our technology supports customers operating across markets, currencies, and regulatory environments, where reliability, security, and scale matter every day.
  
  
As part of Corpay, Inc. (NYSE: CPAY), a global corporate payments company, we combine the pace of a product-led technology team with the reach and stability of a global financial services business. To learn more, visit Payments.corpay.com/cross-border.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:
  
  

* Assigned workspace in our Chennai office
* Company-issued equipment
* Formal, hands-on training

Role Overview
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer at Corpay Cross-Border, you will support the technical onboarding and implementation of clients integrating with Corpay's digital payment and FX solutions.
  
  
The role will primarily support clients and internal stakeholders across North America, with working hours aligned to the US Eastern Time (ET) timezone, while also providing technical support to client implementations and initiatives across other global regions as required.
  
  
You will work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and other Payment Solutions teams to support clients across integration modalities including REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other digital payment capabilities. The role requires strong technical aptitude, analytical problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
In addition to client implementations, Solutions Engineering is regularly relied upon to support special projects, new product initiatives and ad-hoc business requirements. The successful candidate should therefore be comfortable working across a variety of technical challenges and adapting to evolving business priorities.
  
  
The position will be primarily remote; however, the successful candidate will initially attend the Chennai office for induction and training and will be expected to attend occasionally thereafter for team meetings, training and other business requirements.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The Responsibilities Of The Role Will Include**
Client Implementation & Solutioning
  
  

* Support end-to-end technical implementation activities from onboarding through testing, certification and Production go-live.
* Support clients integrating through Corpay's REST APIs, File Upload, SFTP, ERP and other supported integration modalities.
* Participate in technical discovery and solutioning discussions to understand client requirements and determine appropriate implementation approaches.
* Support clients with test environment setup, configuration and integration readiness activities.
* Provide clear and timely responses to client and internal technical implementation questions.
* Support certification testing, Production readiness and post-go-live warranty activities to ensure successful client adoption.
* Take ownership of assigned implementation activities while escalating complex technical or delivery risks appropriately.
* Maintain accurate and timely implementation documentation and project updates.

Technical Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  

* Investigate integration, configuration and implementation issues using appropriate diagnostic tools and available system information.
* Analyse API requests and responses, file structures, payment workflows, logs and other technical data to identify potential causes and solutions.
* Work collaboratively with Technical Sales, Product, Engineering, Client Engagement, Support and other teams to resolve technical blockers.
* Clearly document technical findings, troubleshooting steps and recommended solutions.
* Contribute to testing and validation of new or enhanced product capabilities where Solutions Engineering support is required.

Global Team & Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Work closely with Technical Sales Consultants and the Solutions Engineering Lead to support successful client delivery across North America and, where required, other global regions.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across different geographies and time zones.
* Share lessons learned, technical knowledge and implementation best practices with the wider Solutions Engineering team.
* Contribute to team documentation, implementation standards and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Maintain effective communication with North American stakeholders while remaining connected to the wider Chennai and global Payment Solutions organisation.

Special Projects, Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Support special and ad-hoc business initiatives requiring technical analysis, implementation support, testing, reporting or other Solutions Engineering expertise.
* Support Product and other stakeholders with the testing, analysis and rollout of new technical capabilities where appropriate.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation and business processes through automation and improved tooling.
* Develop, maintain or enhance automated workflows using tools such as Microsoft Power Automate where appropriate.
* Work with stakeholders to understand automation requirements and translate them into practical and supportable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency, scalability and delivery quality.
* Contribute to the continued standardisation and improvement of Solutions Engineering processes, documentation and implementation approaches.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Sales, implementation consulting, technical support, or a comparable client-facing technical role, ideally within payments, fintech or financial services.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, take ownership of client-facing technical issues and implementations, and exercise sound judgement when determining when escalation is required.
* Hands-on experience with REST APIs, file-based integrations, SFTP and/or ERP solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience using tools such as Postman, SQL, Kibana, SEQ, Jira, Confluence or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Experience within payments, fintech, banking or financial services would be advantageous.
* Experience supporting North American clients or working across US time zones would be beneficial.
* Exposure to workflow automation tools such as Microsoft Power Automate or equivalent would be advantageous.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Ability to adapt to ad-hoc projects, new technical requirements and changing business priorities.
* Strong organisational skills with attention to delivery timelines, quality and stakeholder communication.

Benefits & Perks
  
  

* Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave.
* Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance.
* Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family.
* Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support.
* Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension.
* Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

title: Servicenow-Application Engineer
description:

**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
